Amdocs helps the world’s leading communications and media companies deliver exceptional customer experiences through reliable, efficient, and secure operations at scale. We provide software products and services that embed intelligence into how work runs across business, IT, and network domains –delivering measurable outcomes in customer experience, network performance, cloud modernization, and revenue growth. With our talented people, and more than forty years of experience running mission-critical systems around the globe, Amdocs runs billions of transactions daily. Our technology is relied on every day, connecting people worldwide and advancing a more inclusive, connected world. Together, we help those who shape the future to make it amazing. Amdocs is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market (NASDAQ: DOX) and reported revenue of $4.53 billion in fiscal 2025. For more information, visit www.amdocs.com At Amdocs, our mission is to empower our employees to 'Live Amazing, Do Amazing' every day. We believe in creating a workplace where you not only excel professionally but also thrive personally. Through our culture of making a real impact, fostering growth, embracing flexibility, and building connections, we enable them to live meaningful lives while making a difference in the world. In one sentence What will your job look like? Perform end-to-end OSP engineering and fiber network design according to customer requirements, engineering guidelines, and construction standards. Design and draft optimal fiber routes by performing feasibility analysis while considering cost, constructability, quality, and timelines. Develop cost-effective engineering designs within customer systems and construction budgets. Plan fiber/copper cable routes , including aerial placement on poles and underground cable placement as per construction requirements. Deliver high-quality designs to minimize rework and multiple quality checks. Ensure timely client submissions while meeting OTP, quality, and delivery targets . Proactively raise technical queries, concerns, and project dependencies. Work within defined timelines and adapt quickly to changing priorities and project requirements. Take constructive feedback from QCs/Leads and continuously improve quality and efficiency. For senior/expert positions, serve as a Technical SME/POC , providing mentoring, technical guidance, and knowledge transfer to team members. Support team members in improving productivity, technical capability, and design quality. Take ownership of assigned deliverables and support initiation and closure of new scopes of work. Contribute ideas toward automation, process optimization, and continuous improvement . Actively participate in training and feedback sessions and apply learning to project delivery. Be flexible to work across teams/projects and take on additional responsibilities based on business requirements. Tools & Technologies Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: ARAMIS | IQGeo | WALDO | QGIS | ArcGIS | 3GIS | CGIS | SpatialNET | COMSof | NDS | FROGS | AutoCAD | FMS | O-Calc | Smallworld | Netwin | WebGIS All you need is... Experience 2–8 years of experience in Fiber Network Design Engineering / OSP Engineering. 2–4 years: Fiber Design Engineer level. 5–8 years: Senior / Expert Fiber Engineer level with additional technical ownership, mentoring, and SME responsibilities. Relevant experience in ASE, F1/F3, F2, Greenfield/DFIB or similar fiber network scopes. AT&T project experience is preferred. Demonstrates strong knowledge and hands-on experience in copper working Pairs, LST/Throw, Research, PRQ jobs, Copper Relocation/Removal/Replacement, and Copper Reclaim activities. B.Tech in any Engineering or equivalent Relevant OSP/Fiber Design, GIS, AutoCAD, or telecom certifications will be an added advantage. Why you will love this job: Amdocs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce

About the Role Join Applied Materials as a PAM & Secrets Management Engineer to lead privileged access management and secrets management initiatives across our global enterprise infrastructure. You'll architect and operate enterprise-scale PAM solutions (CyberArk) and HashiCorp Vault, working at the intersection of security, DevOps, and cloud platforms to protect critical systems and enable secure development. Key Responsibilities Privileged Access Management (PAM) Design, implement, and manage enterprise PAM solutions at scale (500+ concurrent sessions, 2K+ daily logins, 2.5K+ targets) Operate and maintain CyberArk self-hosted environment lead evaluation of alternatives (Delinea, BeyondTrust, CyberArk Privilege Cloud) Architect privileged session management (PSM) for RDP, SSH with native client support and passwordless credential injection Implement automated account discovery and onboarding workflows (Windows local, AD, Linux/Unix accounts) Configure session recording, monitoring, and alerting for compliance and security Troubleshoot and resolve PAM infrastructure stability issues (eliminating outages) Secrets Management Architect and operate HashiCorp Vault Enterprise at scale across multi-cloud environments Implement Vault secrets engines: KV v2, Dynamic Secrets (LDAP, Azure, databases), PKI, Transit Encryption Design and deploy Vault authentication methods: OIDC/JWT, Kubernetes, AppRole, AWS IAM, Azure AD Configure Vault policies and namespaces for multi-tenant secret isolation Integrate Vault with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) for secure secret injection Implement Vault Agent and sidecar injectors for application secret delivery Configure Vault auto-unseal with cloud KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP Cloud KMS) Manage Vault high availability, disaster recovery, and performance tuning Implement secret rotation automation for databases, cloud credentials, and API keys Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with CI/CD, Network, Cloud, and Platform teams to integrate PAM/SM controls Lead incident response for privileged access breaches and secrets exposure events Conduct security assessments and ensure compliance with SOX, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001 Automate PAM and Secret Management workflows using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible Required Qualifications Privileged Access Management (PAM) Expertise: 5+ years hands-on experience with enterprise PAM solutions at scale (10,000+ employees or global infrastructure) Deep experience with privileged session management: RDP, SSH session recording, monitoring, and credential injection Strong understanding of account lifecycle management: discovery, onboarding, rotation for Windows local, AD, Linux/Unix accounts Experience with PAM platforms: CyberArk (PAS, PVWA, CPM, PSM) or equivalent (BeyondTrust, Delinea, Arcon) Knowledge of least privilege principles and privilege elevation workflows Experience integrating PAM with approval workflows (ServiceNow, ITSM tools) Understanding of session isolation, credential vaulting, and password/SSH key rotation Familiarity with PAM architecture: high availability, disaster recovery, horizontal scaling Secrets Management Expertise: 3+ years hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault in production environments Deep knowledge of Vault secrets engines: KV (v1/v2), Dynamic Secrets (databases, AWS, Azure), PKI, Transit, SSH, TOTP Experience with Vault authentication methods: Kubernetes, AppRole, OIDC/JWT, AWS IAM, Azure AD, LDAP, TLS Certificates Strong understanding of Vault policies, namespaces, and entity/identity management Experience with Vault Agent, sidecar injectors, and application integration patterns Knowledge of Vault operations: auto-unseal (HSM), replication (DR/Performance), backup/restore, upgrades Experience integrating Vault with CI/CD pipelines for dynamic secret injection Understanding of secret zero problem and secure secret bootstrap mechanisms Technical & Cloud Skills: Multi-cloud secrets management: AWS Secrets Manager/IAM, Azure Key Vault/Managed Identity, GCP Secret Manager Experience with Kubernetes: Vault sidecar injection, CSI secret driver, external secrets operator Proficiency in scripting and automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go (preferred) Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform, Ansible (Vault configuration automation) Understanding of PKI fundamentals: certificate lifecycle, CA hierarchies, mTLS, certificate-based authentication Experience with Directory services: Active Directory, LDAP (for PAM/Vault integration) Collaboration & Communication Skills: Proven track record working with DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud, and Network teams Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders Ability to lead cross-functional PAM/SM initiative

As a Manufacturing Engineer, you are responsible for developing and maintaining methods, operating sequences, and processes in the fabrication of parts, components, subassemblies, and final assemblies. You'll work closely with other engineering functions to coordinate the release of product improvements and new products, and you'll use engineering principles to estimate and reduce manufacturing costs, improve product quality, determine time standards, and make recommendations for tooling and process requirements. Your expertise in lean principles, automation, and continuous improvement will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and achieving higher levels of productivity and cost-effectiveness. You'll develop and use test procedures, evaluate test results, and assess work methods, procedures, and policies to identify root cause issues and solutions that ensure operational success. We are looking for a highly talented integration engineer to join our team and integrate complex multi-disciplinary systems modules (Scanning Electron Microscopes). What’s in it for you? As part of our team, you will work together with great people, hands-on with one of the most complex multi-disciplinary systems in the market, putting into practice many of the fields from your studies. Our Group: The team is responsible for system Scanning Electron Microscopes integration for Applied Materials - Metrology and Inspection tools before shipment to the customer. In addition, we lead R&D prototypes and new products in the organization, with large exposure to the most advanced technologies such as precise mechanics, electronics, motion and optics. What you'll be doing: The system integration engineer gets a fully assembled Scanning Electron Microscopes. His job is to calibrate and test a multi-disciplinary system, in clean room environment, from start to end until shipment to the customer includes complicated troubleshooting, investigation and engineering solutions proposal. Since we are talking about a Scanning Electron Microscopes with Very high complexity multi-disciplinary system involving several modules and disciplines, such as E-Beam (Electron-beam Microscopy), high-end optics, lasers, precise mechanics, RF, motion and control etc., the essence of our work requires high system understanding, deep engineering knowledge and high accountability level. Role and responsibilities: - 1. Responsible for technical support to meet the system’s specifications & team KPIs: on time delivery, Operational aspects of the tool’s integration process, Lab Tool fleet performance 2. Performs highly complex operational and functional tests, calibrations, verification of sub-assemblies and/or systems 3. Troubleshoots modules and fully integrates systems. Performs in-house customer acceptance tests. 4. Travels to Applied materials - PDC Israel site to install and support tools. 5. Follow and complete documentation procedures and forms of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Pursue and develop procedural, safety and process improvements. Identify problems and resolve problems as an individual or as a team. 6. Working 5 days/week from Bangalore Office (Saturday & Sunday a must). What should you have? Bachelor's degree B. Tech Electrical Engineer 2-4 years of relevant technical experience: System integration experience or other high complex technical background - Advantage 10 - 30% travelling Team player, Highly Creative and Proactive High level of independent work with constant drive for improvement This is a physically demanding position that often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Functional Knowledge Demonstrates expanded conceptual knowledge in own discipline and broadens capabilities Business Expertise Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work Leadership No supervisory responsibilities but provides informal guidance to new team members Problem Solving Solves problems in straightforward situations; analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents Impact Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team; works within guidelines and policies Interpersonal Skills Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations Additional Information Time Type: Full time Employee Type: Assignee / Regular Travel: Yes, 25% of the Time Relocation Eligible: Yes Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer with strong expertise in C++ development to design, develop, and maintain high-performance software applications. The ideal candidate should have a solid foundation in software engineering principles, object-oriented design, multithreaded programming, and system-level development. The role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable software solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software features for semiconductor CAD applications using modern C++. Develop efficient, reusable, and reliable code with a focus on performance and maintainability, following established coding standards and best practices. Implement and optimize algorithms for layout data processing, geometry operations, and pattern matching under technical guidance. Translate design specifications and requirements into working, well-documented software. Own the development of software features, including implementation, unit testing, and integration testing. Analyze and resolve software defects and performance issues, and implement robust bug fixes. Contribute to software quality through code reviews, unit testing, and test automation. Participate in technical design discussions and design reviews. Work closely with product management, QA, and engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions. Prepare and maintain software documentation, test procedures, and release notes. Required Skills Technical Skills Proficiency in modern C++ (C++11/14/17) with 4–8 years of software development experience. Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and common design patterns. Working knowledge of STL, templates, smart pointers, and memory management. Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms; exposure to computational geometry is a plus. Experience developing multi-threaded or concurrent applications. Understanding of Operating Systems (Windows/Linux). Experience with source control systems such as Git. Familiarity with debugging, profiling, and performance optimization techniques. Preferred Skills Familiarity with microservices architecture. Familiarity with gRPC and REST APIs. Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks. Familiarity working with large-scale data processing systems Desired Candidate Profile Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, Agile development environment. Self-motivated and capable of driving tasks to completion with limited supervision. Strong ownership, accountability, and customer focus. Passion for technology, innovation, and continuous learning. Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. About the Role We are seeking a highly motivated Algorithm Developer to develop advanced computer vision, machine learning, and image processing solutions for next-generation semiconductor inspection and metrology systems. The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, optimization, and deployment of innovative algorithms that enable critical product capabilities and deliver measurable customer value. Key Responsibilities Algorithm Development Design, develop, and optimize advanced inspection and metrology algorithms for semiconductor applications. Apply state-of-the-art techniques in computer vision, image processing, machine learning, and deep learning to solve complex product and customer challenges. Participate in feature definition, technical design reviews, implementation planning, and release activities. Investigate and resolve product issues, customer escalations, and field-related algorithm challenges. Contribute to all phases of algorithm development, including concept generation, prototyping, implementation, testing, optimization, and product release. Document technical designs, validation results, and development best practices. Strong programming skills in C++ and Python. Solid understanding of computer vision, image processing, machine learning, and deep learning techniques. Experience developing algorithms for complex, hardware-integrated systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience working in cross-functional engineering teams. Strong written and verbal technical communication skills. Preferred Technical Skills Semiconductor: Experience in semiconductor inspection, metrology, semiconductor equipment, or a related industry. Computer Vision: Detection, segmentation, registration, alignment, classification, and anomaly detection. Machine Learning & Deep Learning: CNNs, transformers, self-supervised learning, and model optimization. Programming: C++, Python, OpenCV, NumPy, PyTorch, and TensorFlow. High-Performance Computing: CUDA, GPU acceleration, and CPU compute optimization. Data Analysis & Visualization: Statistical analysis, experiment design, and performance characterization. eightfold:citi:859038181394.description: Job Summary We are seeking a data-driven professional to join our DWCS (Digital Workplace and Client Services) Data and Analytics team. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable insights. You will develop and manage key metrics, automated data pipelines, and interactive dashboards that provide visibility into the effectiveness of our access control environment, helping to identify security risks and drive strategic improvements. Key Responsibilities ● Develop & Maintain Metrics: Design, build, and maintain Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), operational reports, and dashboards to monitor the health, compliance, and effectiveness of DWCS services. ● Data Analysis & Anomaly Detection: Analyze large, multi-source datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and potential security risks related to user access, entitlements, client services and privileged accounts. ● Reporting & Visualization: Create compelling, interactive data visualizations and present analytical findings to stakeholders and leadership to support data-driven decision-making. ● Advanced Analytics, Predictive Modeling & AI Integration: Responsible for developing, validating, and applying statistical models, predictive analytics, and Generative/Agentic AI workflows to enhance analytical capabilities, automate complex data reasoning, and deliver forward-looking security intelligence. ● Ad-Hoc Analysis & Decision Support: Perform exploratory and ad-hoc data analyses across multi-source DWCS datasets to address urgent security/operational queries and deliver actionable insights for leadership. ● Data Engineering & Pipeline Maintenance: Build, maintain, and optimize batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL queries, and automated data refresh processes to ensure clean, reliable, and timely data feeds for BI and reporting platforms. ● Collaboration: Partner with operations, engineering, cybersecurity, and governance teams to understand their data requirements and deliver ongoing analytical support. ● Process Improvement & Data Integrity: Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes, establish data quality frameworks, and enhance data integrity across source systems. Qualifications and Competencies: - Basic Qualifications ● Experience: 5–8 years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data engineering. ● Data Analysis & Tools: Strong proficiency with data analysis and scripting tools such as SQL, Python, and Excel. ● Data Engineering: Proven experience in building and optimizing ETL/ELT data pipelines, managing batch/real-time data ingestion, and writing complex SQL queries for large, multi-source datasets. ● Data Visualization: Hands-on expertise with enterprise data visualization tools such as Tableau. ● Core Skills: Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and written/verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications ● Advanced Analytics & AI (Preferred): Familiarity with statistical/predictive modeling (forecasting, regression), Generative AI (LLMs, RAG), and Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, tool-calling) to automate data reasoning and analytics workflows. ------------------------------------------------------ Job Family Group: Technology ------------------------------------------------------ Job Family: Systems & Engineering ------------------------------------------------------ Time Type: Full time ------------------------------------------------------ Most Relevant Skills Please see the requirements listed above. ------------------------------------------------------ Other Relevant Skills For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter. ------------------------------------------------------ Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. eightfold:citi:859038301446.description: We are seeking an experienced and results-driven PySpark / Big Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain large-scale batch and real-time data pipelines. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex raw data into actionable analytical data models, optimizing distributed computing workloads, and ensuring data integrity, scalability, and security across enterprise data platforms. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Apache Spark architecture, advanced Python programming, distributed systems optimization, modern cloud platforms, and data warehousing/lakehouse paradigms. Key Responsibilities Data Pipeline Design & Development Architect, build, and maintain robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark and Python to ingest data from diverse batch and streaming sources (Kafka, relational databases, REST APIs, Object Storage). Design and implement Lakehouse architectures using formats such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi . Build reusable frameworks and data ingestion libraries to standardize enterprise data processing. Spark Performance Tuning & Optimization Diagnose and tune Spark application performance, managing memory allocation, partitions, execution plans, broadcast joins, data skews, and garbage collection. Optimize query execution plans using Catalyst Optimizer and Tungsten execution engine. Monitor and troubleshoot production Spark jobs across cluster management environments (YARN, Kubernetes, or Databricks). Data Modeling & Architecture Collaborate with Data Architects to design dimensional (Star/Snowflake), normalized, and Data Vault schemas optimized for analytical workloads. Ensure efficient data storage, partitioning strategies, and file format selection (Parquet, ORC, Avro). Orchestration, CI/CD & DevOps Schedule and orchestrate complex workflow DAGs using workflow orchestrators such as Apache Airflow , Prefect, or Dagster. Implement CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) for automated testing, packaging, and deployment of data pipelines. Write unit tests, integration tests, and data validation routines (e.g., Great Expectations, PyTest). Governance, Security & Quality Implement enterprise data governance, lineage tracking, metadata management, and data quality frameworks. Ensure strict compliance with data security, masking, tokenization, RBAC, and regulatory privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA). Required Technical Qualifications & Skills Core Technologies - Apache Spark, PySpark (Spark SQL, DataFrames, Datasets, Structured Streaming), Python 3.x Database & Querying - Advanced SQL, Query optimization, Indexing, Window functions Data Lake & Lakehouse - Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Parquet, Avro, ORC Workflow & Orchestration - Apache Airflow, Luigi, Prefect, or Databricks Workflows Cloud Platforms - AWS (EMR, Glue, S3, Redshift), Azure (Synapse, ADLS, HDInsight), or GCP (Dataproc, BigQuery, GCS) Streaming Technologies - Apache Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Event Hubs, or Kinesis Key Competencies & Experience Distributed Computing Fundamentals: In-depth knowledge of Spark internals (RDD, Catalyst Optimizer, DAG execution, Shuffling, Narrow vs. Wide dependencies). Production Experience: Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade PySpark applications at enterprise scale. Problem Solving: Proven track record in debugging memory bottlenecks, Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors, and resolving data skew issues. Data Engineering Best Practices: Experience implementing modular code architectures, logging, monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch), and alerting. 5. Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have) Hands-on experience with Databricks platform (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Photon engine, MLflow). Familiarity with Scala/Java in addition to Python. Knowledge of DataOps and Infrastructure as Code ( Terraform , CloudFormation). Experience with modern analytical data warehouses (Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift). Relevant certifications: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate / Professional AWS Certified Data Engineer / Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)CCA Spark and Hadoop Developer (or equivalent) 6. Educational Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience). Recommended Qualifications: 5-8 years of relevant experience Experience in systems analysis and programming of software applications Experience in managing and implementing successful projects Working knowledge of consulting/project management techniques/methods Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. The Senior Reconciliation Developer – Assistant Vice President (AVP / C12) is a hands-on technical individual contributor responsible for the end-to-end design, development, configuration, and optimization of enterprise-grade data reconciliations and automated control pipelines. Operating with a high level of technical autonomy, the incumbent drives reconciliation engineering across high-throughput transaction processing systems, general ledger architectures, and centralized data distribution platforms. The role serves as a key technical subject matter expert (SME) delivering robust risk controls, automated break classification logic, and scalable data pipelines for strategic initiatives including enterprise finance automation, Target Operating Model (TOM) expansion across Capital Markets, and mandatory control onboarding for 200+ critical application feeds. Hybrid Schedule: 2 or 3 full days per week on-site in the office, with remaining days worked remotely in accordance with enterprise hybrid work policies. End-to-End Rule Build & Configuration: Design, build, test, and deploy complex multi-way matching algorithms, tolerance rules, and automated adjustment logic on enterprise reconciliation engines (e.g., TLM SmartStream, Duco, Gresham, or proprietary enterprise matching engines). Break Classification & Exception Handling: Engineer automated break classification and triage models to categorize discrepancies, assign break ownership, and accelerate root-cause analysis. Scalable Data Pipeline Development: Develop and optimize high-throughput data extraction, transformation, and ingestion pipelines using Python (Advanced), SQL (Advanced), and Apache Spark / PySpark for large-scale financial and transactional datasets. Technical Specification & BRD Translation: Partner with business analysts, operations teams, and product owners to translate Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) into detailed technical designs, data mapping specifications, and schema definitions. Data Sourcing & Lineage Verification: Validate data integrity, provenance, and transformation logic from upstream Systems of Record (SoRs) into central data distribution hubs and analytical repositories. Backlog Remediation Execution: Systematically analyze, develop, and deploy automated reconciliation solutions to clear active request backlogs (340+ scheduled and ad-hoc requests). DevOps & Containerized Deployment: Package and deploy services utilizing Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift container platforms; maintain automated CI/CD build and test pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitLab). Audit, Risk & Control Adherence: Ensure all built reconciliations satisfy internal audit, risk management, and regulatory control mandates as a required supervisory control mechanism. Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the go-to technical authority on reconciliation logic, data schemas, and pipeline performance for peer developers, QA analysts, and business partners. Stakeholder Alignment: Actively liaise with upstream data providers, downstream consumers, operations specialists, and enterprise architecture leads to resolve data friction and ensure delivery milestones are met. • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Financial Tech

eightfold:citi:859038534679.description: Overview We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled .NET Developer. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, coupled with knowledge of Markets domain in Kazakhstan. This role requires development of the following in-country applications: The in-country applications maintain several critical business functions for Markets Operations, including: Downloading market data, FX, and repo deals from the Kazakhstan stock exchange and their further submission to downstream applications. Downloading swap, spot, and forward deals from upstream applications and their further submission to the Kazakhstan central depository. Downloading exchange rates from the National Bank. Regulatory reporting to the National Bank. Risk reporting to downstream applications. Downloading broker deals from the Kazakhstan stock exchange and their further submission to downstream applications. Downloading exchange rates from the National Bank. Regulatory reporting to the National Bank. Reconciliation report submission to downstream applications. The application's functionality is mandated by local regulations as described in PUBN-135221 “Requirements for software and hardware and other equipment necessary for carrying out activities on the securities market” and PUBN-169822 “NBK Resolution #110 dated December 24, 2025, ‘On approval of the Rules for the submission of reports by professional participants in the securities market and the unified accumulative pension fund.’” Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain responsive, user-friendly web interfaces using C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, and CSS, ensuring performance and usability standards are met. Design, develop, and maintain responsive, user-friendly classical windows applications using Delphi RAD Studio. Develop backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture. Experience in Core Java / J2EE development and proficiency with Spring Framework and Caching frameworks. Experience building web platforms with React/Web. Architect and develop scalable database schemas, stored procedures in PL/SQL and T-SQL, and functions across relational and SQL database platforms, including MSSQL and Oracle, to support application requirements. Create and maintain automated workflows that interact with multiple APIs, databases, and application UIs to drive system integration and process efficiency. Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and analysts to translate requirements into user stories and provide technical sizing estimates to support prioritization and delivery planning. Design, build, and maintain RESTful microservices and backend services using .NET Core, adhering to microservices architecture principles and design patterns. Manage code promotion activities and SDLC compliance artifacts, ensuring all required documentation and governance checkpoints are met throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Maintain code repository hygiene and ensure developer metrics are consistently achieved across branches, commits, and version control practices. Participate in UAT testing cycles and resolve defects in a timely manner to protect release schedules and ensure quality delivery. Support CI/CD pipeline operations and DevOps tooling (Tekton, Teamcity, GitHub, uDeploy, SonarQube) to facilitate reliable, automated deployment and continuous integration practices. Contribute to Agile ceremonies including sprint grooming, backlog refinement, and delivery planning, taking ownership of assigned tasks through to completion. Qualifications 4-8 years' experience in development with expertise in .NET Core, .NET Framework, C#, Angular, TypeScript, and CSS for front-end; and .NET Core, .NET Framework microservices for back-end. Strong hands-on experience with database design and development across MS SQL and Oracle, including schema design, stored procedures, and query optimization. Solid understanding of microservices architecture and design patterns, with the ability to design, build, and maintain distributed, loosely coupled services. Proficiency in RESTful API design, development, and integration, including experience consuming and exposing APIs across complex enterprise systems. Familiarity with DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines, including Tekton, Teamcity, GitHub, uDeploy, SonarQube, with practical experience in deployment automation and version control workflows. Proven ability to translate business and functional requirements into technical user stories, provide effort estimates, and deliver code that meets project and compliance standards. Experience in the Financial Services industry, specifically within the FX and Securities Markets domain is preferred. Understanding of the role of National Bank, Stock Exchange, Central depository and underlying legislation in Kazakhstan is highly sought. Experience managing SDLC artifacts and code promotion processes in compliance-driven enterprise environments. Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and OpenShift is a plus. Experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium) and a working knowledge of software quality assurance practices. Familiarity with AI fundamentals, including prompt engineering and interaction with AI/ML-integrated tooling, is a plus. ------------------------------------------------------ Job Family Group: Technology ------------------------------------------------------ Job Family: Applications Development ------------------------------------------------------ Time Type: Full time ------------------------------------------------------ Most Relevant Skills Please see the requirements listed above. ------------------------------------------------------ Other Relevant Skills For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter. ------------------------------------------------------ Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration w

eightfold:citi:859038611224.description: We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team. In this role, you will assist in designing, building, maintaining, and optimizing scalable data pipelines, data warehouses, and analytics infrastructure. You will work closely with senior data engineers, data scientists, software developers, and business stakeholders to transform raw data into structured, actionable data assets for reporting, advanced analytics, and operational systems. Key Responsibilities 1. Data Pipeline Development & Maintenance (ETL / ELT) Assist in developing, testing, and maintaining automated ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest structured and unstructured data from diverse sources (APIs, relational databases, streaming services, flat files). Monitor existing data pipelines, troubleshoot data ingestion failures, and implement bug fixes or performance enhancements. Implement data transformation, cleansing, and validation routines to maintain high data quality and consistency. 2. Data Modeling & Storage Support the design and maintenance of relational schemas, dimensional models (star and snowflake schemas), and data lake storage structures. Write and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and views to extract and aggregate data efficiently. Assist in partitioning, indexing, and organizing datasets for optimal query performance. 3. Data Quality & Governance Collaborate with senior engineers to implement data validation checks, monitoring alerts, and data reconciliation processes. Follow enterprise data governance, privacy, and security policies (e.g., role-based access control, encryption, data masking). Document data lineage, metadata definitions, schema changes, and technical architecture. 4. Collaboration & CI/CD Practices Participate in agile/scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospective meetings. Use version control systems (Git) for code management and follow continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices. Collaborate with QA teams and business analysts to conduct integration and user acceptance testing (UAT). Qualifications & Skills Required Education & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience/bootcamp certification). Experience: 2+ years of relevant hands-on experience in data engineering, data analytics, software development, or related academic/internship projects. Key Skills & Technologies Programming Languages Python, SQL (mandatory); familiarity with Java, Scala, or Bash scripting is a plus. Relational Databases & SQL PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL Server, or Oracle. Proficient in joins, window functions, indexing, and aggregations. Data Warehousing & Lakes Familiarity with platforms such as Snowflake, Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift, Databricks, or cloud storage (AWS S3, Azure Blob, GCS). Data Processing Frameworks Basic understanding of Apache Spark, PySpark, Pandas, or Polars. Workflow Orchestration Exposure to tools like Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or cron-based job scheduling. Version Control & DevOps Git/GitHub/GitLab, basic containerization (Docker), and exposure to CI/CD pipelines. Soft Skills & Competencies Problem Solving: Strong analytical thinking and troubleshooting mindset with attention to detail. Communication: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Eagerness to Learn: Self-starter with a proactive attitude toward learning modern data architectures, cloud technologies, and best practices. Teamwork: Strong collaborative skills and ability to thrive in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications Cloud certification (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Data Analytics, Azure Data Fundamentals DP-900 / DP-203, or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer). Familiarity with modern data stack tools such as dbt (data build tool) , Kafka, or Delta Lake. Understanding of basic DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts (e.g., Terraform, Kubernetes). Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker). Strong Python and SQL expertise Hands on with Shell scripts, PySpark, Hadoop ecosystem Knowledge on DevOps, CICD pipeline ------------------------------------------------------ Job Family Group: Technology ------------------------------------------------------ Job Family: Applications Development ------------------------------------------------------ Time Type: Full time ------------------------------------------------------ Most Relevant Skills Please see the requirements listed above. ------------------------------------------------------ Other Relevant Skills For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter. ------------------------------------------------------ Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. eightfold:citi:859038766500.description: Job Description: Are you a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer looking to make a significant impact in the dynamic world of finance? Join our cutting-edge technology team and play a pivotal role in developing and enhancing our proprietary “Margin Calculations and Reporting” Platform, a critical component of our Prime Finance Services organization. This is an exceptional opportunity to apply your technical expertise to complex, computing-intensive financial solutions within a collaborative and globally connected environment. This role is at the heart of our Prime Services division, where you will contribute to the evolution of a sophisticated margin calculation engine. This engine leverages a complex model and intricate business logic to provide leverage to clients and reduce risk for Citi, directly impacting our financial operations. As a Software Engineer, you will be instrumental in delivering end-to-end software solutions, ensuring scalability, performance, and robustness for our critical financial systems globally. The Applications Development Intermediate Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities. Responsibilities: As a key member of our global development team, you will: Innovate & Develop: Design, develop, and implement robust and scalable application systems and programs for the Margin Calculation Services and reporting, aligning with strategic technology initiatives. Problem Solve: Consult with users, clients, and other technology groups on issues, and recommend programming solutions. Analyze complex technical and business challenges, and propose innovative solutions that enhance system functionality and business processes. Project work: Monitor and guide all phases of the software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through construction, testing, and implementation, ensuring timely and high-quality project delivery. Provide user and operational support on applications to business users Strategic Impact: Utilize your expertise in application development to make evaluative judgments, recommend security measures, and contribute to post-implementation analysis, ensuring optimal system design and functionality. Collaboration & Consultation: Partner closely with project managers, business stakeholders, and senior managers to translate complex business requirements into well-architected technical solutions. Consult with users and other technology groups, providing advanced programming insights and support. Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to best practices and essential procedures. Autonomy & Ownership: Operate with a high degree of independence and judgment, taking ownership of critical initiatives and driving them to successful completion. Risk Management: Proactively assess and manage technical risks, demonstrating a strong commitment to regulatory compliance, ethical judgment, and transparent reporting of control issues. Qualifications: 4-5 years of relevant experience in the Financial Service industry Intermediate level experience in Applications Development role Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making skills Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements Technical Expertise : Strong proficiency in Java application technologies, including deep experience with TDD (Test-Driven Development) , Spring framework , and Microservices architecture . Excellent knowledge of algorithms and data structures, design patterns. Experience in systems analysis and programming of software applications Strong Java experience : Java core, collections, concurrency, streams Frameworks and APIs: Spring (Core, Batch, Integration, MVC, Boot, Data), Hibernate, Jackson , JAX RS, JPA, JAXB Experience with distributed caches like Apache Gemfire will be a plus Messaging: JMS, Kafka Testing: JUnit, Mocking frameworks (Mockito, Power Mock) Experience in performance enhancements using parallel processing, multithreading. Understanding locking/synchronization Understanding Docker and Kubernetes Experience in RESTful API development and integration, deployment framework and source control experience such as Git. Solid understanding and experience with SQL . Proficiency in Linux environments. Experience with job scheduling. Education: Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Front-End Development : Strong knowledge in developing intuitive user interfaces using contemporary JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React), HTML5, and CSS. Back-End Development : Solid experience in developing server-side logic and APIs using languages such as Java, Python, or similar. CI/CD and DevOps : Proficiency with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools for building (e.g., pypi) and deploying code (e.g., Docker, Jenkins, OpenShift). Agile Methodologies : Practical experience working within Agile development methodologies and utilizing project management tools such as JIRA. Testing Automation : Ability to develop and automate comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality. Version Control : Solid understanding and practical experience with code versioning tools, including GitHub Enterprise and Bitbucket. Education: A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field is required. A master's degree is preferred. eightfold:eaton:687238959001.description: What you’ll do: Eaton India Innovation Center has an opening for a Engineer- Aerospace test Lab. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the requirement of this position is to perform testing and provide assistance to engineering personnel to setup, install and on-time completion of accurate product and /or system testing in accordance with specific test procedures as defined by the Aerospace product engineering functions team. Requirement of this position is to perform testing and provide assistance to engineering personnel to setup, install and on-time completion of accurate product and /or system testing in accordance with specific test procedures as defined by the Aerospace product engineering functions team. The position requires to : a) Perform installation of mechanical setups: sound knowledge of hydraulics b) Perform test setups in completion of specific and standard test processes for Hydraulic test stand and complete test requests within acceptable time. c) Perform the test of hydraulic products such as Pump, Valves, Hose Assy , Couplings, Environmental chambers and fitting as per the mentioned process (Aerospace AS , DO-160 or customer specified standard) d) Knowledge in LabVIEW, selection of components for fatigue testing (Impulse, burst etc.), Selection of appropriate sensors, valves with practical experience in developing customized solutions and implementing applications. e) Provide the recommendations to product team on design improvement based on the test results. f) Should able to trouble shoot and update the test stand for any new test requirement or standard g) Should design the test circuit with minimal support and build the same for testing. h) Standardization of test procedures in test lab and adhere to ISO17025 and AS9100 standards i) Implement (DMAIC / Lean) successfully in Laboratory . Improve productivity by standardization and continuous improvement, Participate & implement continuous improvement/ best practices, implement digitalization tools in lab j) Create SOP’s and processes / procedures for Individual test stands and implements in Lab k) Provide technical leadership to the test lab technician team and perform quality checks to ensure testing meets Eaton / Customer / International standards, Review and Approve the test request and provide feedback to test personnel Qualifications: Graduate in Mechanical, Aerospace , Automotive engineering 5 to 7 years of relevant work experience Skills: '-Essential Functions 1.Good knowledge in Hydraulic and Pneumatic Systems and Equipment Development Lifecycle Expertise and demonstrated during equipment build 2.Good knowledge in Pump selection, testing and its Assembly/Disassembly 3.Analyzing mechanical assembly issues related to hydraulics components is most preferred. 4.Troubleshooting elementary product and test rig issues, and performing data analysis required by the product group 5.Understanding of data acquisition systems, hardware and software that are being used for testing 6.Ability to fix issues with test rigs and lab and work with his peer engineer to improve or develop any new methods solving the issues 7.Preferred reading fixture drawings 8.Articulating and generating good technical reports based on test observations 9.Train and monitor fellow technicians and drive completion of tests in prescribed time frame 10.Work with engineers within group to define and perform custom testing as requested by customer 11.Strive to meet test lab performance targets established in Balanced Score Card and ensure ISO compliance -Required: Product knowledge of aerospace hydraulic pumps, sensors, Hose assy. QD’s etc. Sound experience to Lead design and development of new Hydraulics /Electromechanical equipment’s Experience in assembly and tear down of hydraulic systems Excellent problem solving and tests stand troubleshooting skill & well conversant with relevant tools like 8D (FRACAS) for the test lab Experience in test circuit design as per the requirement. Awareness and experience in following Safety & Quality Management Practice Experience on fault identification and able to propose corrective actions Clear understanding about sensors, Diadem, electronic components of DAQ & control software i.e. LabVIEW etc. Experience in problem solving & continuous improvement through LEAN tool deployment for test equipment utilization and cost savings

eightfold:eaton:687239390396.description: What you’ll do: Eaton India Innovation Center (EIIC) – M&S ES Americas team has an Engineer open position. The primary responsibility of this role is to perform simulations of electrical products breakers/switchgear/UPS from MBD (Multi Body Dynamics )/vibration/Static technology. Individual will be required to partner with local and global teams, understand the design intent, develop and validate simulation models to substantiate the engineering designs. Individual should have sound knowledge of Mechanical systems, Vibration & Mechanics modelling techniques in ADAMS/ANSYS Workbench and allied software. The primary function for this position includes: • Collaborates with technology and product teams to define problem statements • Understands project requirements and solves problems in discussion with local as well as global stakeholders. • Understand existing simulation modeling methodologies & assist to mature further • Deploys developed simulation methodologies to strengthen “Analysis First” strategy on electrical products 1. Develops simulation models for MBD/Vibration/Static CTQ to evaluate critical performance of electrical products. 2. Analyze,Interpret, summarize and communicate simulation results to global audience and provide technical and/or design recommendations.. 3. Delivers deep insights through simulations for robust product development to meet performance requirements/ CTQs for electrical products. 4. Coordinates with stakeholders to understand analysis requirements, create analysis approach & solve simple/medium complex problems 5. Understand & assist in maturing analysis capability of Structural technology domain for electrical productline. 6. Engage with product and test engineer to improve analysis models and validate analysis approach with test data. 7.Demonstrates CI mindset & indentify opportunities to automate repetative tasks. Qualifications: MS/ME/M.Tech in Mechanical/Automotive engineering 0-2 Years of relevant experience with multinational engineering organization. Skills: Thorough understanding of dynamic techniques like Fatigue, Static, MBD, Vibration analysis methods. Knowledge of Six Sigma (DfSS) is preferred. Candidate should have excellent English communication (oral and written) and presentation skills and should be a good team player.

eightfold:eaton:687239452584.description: What you’ll do: Eaton announced, on January 26, 2026, the intent to separate its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) into an independent, publicly traded company. We expect to complete the separation by the end of the first quarter of 2027. As a standalone company, the Mobility business will be more focused and agile, creating exciting opportunities for employees to grow, innovate, and help shape the future of mobility. The separation reflects strong confidence in the Mobility team and positions the new company as an employer of choice in the automotive and commercial vehicle industry. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the spinoff closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time. Responsibility: • Create and/or revise DFR deliverables such as Reliability goal setting, Reliability Predictions, Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA), Accelerated Life Test , Reliability Demonstration Test (RDT), Reliability Growth analysis ,FRACAS for NPIs, VAVE projects and/or existing product improvements. • Work with cross functional team as well as global reliability engineering team for designing in reliability on NPI programs and/or existing product improvements,VAVE projects & responsible for identifying, managing and mitigating reliability risks under supervision of senior. • Planning project milestones, executing milestones, conducting deliverables reviews, communication with stakeholder and on-job development through technical mentoring. • Along with warranty monitoring, forecasting, reporting; develop actuarial models library for eMobility components Qualifications: Education level required : Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering. Preferred: Master’s Degree in Reliability Engineering. Experience : 0-1 Years Technical knowledge : • Skilled in the areas of reliability statistics, FMEA, FTA,8D,FRACAS, life modelling & analyzing field/warranty data into relevant life and failure rate information. • Experience with any industry proven reliability analysis suite of tools like Minitab, Reliasoft preferred. • Desired: Work experience in the Eletrical/Electronics systems preferably Power electronics(Inverter/Converters), Power systems, battery, inverters, protection circuits etc. • Preferred: DFSS GB certified from reputed organization, Experience in safety/Reliablility assessment of E/E system Skills: • Process Management-Good at figuring out the processes necessary to get things done, knows how to organize people and activities, knows what to measure and how to measure it, Can simplify complex processes, Gets more out of fewer resources • Problem Solving - Uses rigorous logic and methods to solve difficult problems with effective solutions, probes all fruitful sources for answers, can see hidden problems, Is excellent at honest analysis Looks beyond the obvious and doesn't stop at the first answers • Decision quality – makes good decisions based upon a mixture of analysis, wisdom, experience, and judgment • Drive for results – can be counted on to exceed goals successfully • Interpersonal savvy – relates well to all kinds of people; builds appropriate rapport.

Responsible for activity planning, execution and closing of assigned activities. Confers with manufacturing, Product teams, Printed circuit board fab vendors, suppliers to develop designs and resolve Design for Manufacturing, Design For Testing, Design For Assembly issues. Plans, Organizes, and leads smaller projects. Ensure all Printed Circuit Board design processes and review processes are well understood and followed in every design. Effectively prioritizes and acts with speed and focus. Sound knowledge of electrical & electronic components – Surface Mount & through Hole. • Hands-on experience in creation of footprints and sound knowledge of IPC Standards like IPC2221A, IPC-SM-782 and IPC 7351, UL and MIL standards, PCB library management, Prepare schematics, performs layout design. • Awareness of CIS / CIP database, thermal management, Enclosure designs. • Experience with PCB manufacturing process (Design for Manufacturing, assembly and testing) and validation of Gerbers using CAM350. • Good knowledge of PCB design guidelines for EMI / EMC aspects, some exposure on hardware testing • Hands on experience with high speed board designs, Signal Integrity & Power Integrity analysis using Ansys or equivalent tool. • Automotive domain knowledge for High power Layout designs. • Good interpersonal, written and oral communication skills Yes! Because you are the one we are looking for, we hope to hear from you now! Job tag: #LI-RT1

eightfold:eaton:687239995759.description: What you’ll do: The Modeling & Simulation Center of Excellence for ES Americas is seeking an Engineer – Electromagnetics to support the design and development of electrical products, including switchgear, busway, switches, UPS, circuit protection devices, and related assemblies. The incumbent will develop and validate Electromagentic models to predict Magnetostatic & Dielectric performance. The role requires close collaboration with product engineering, test, and global technical teams to understand design intent, define analysis requirements, interpret results, and provide practical design recommendations. The engineer will contribute to Eaton’s Analysis First strategy by independently executing moderately complex analyses by applying electromagnetics simulation methods, while delivering high-quality results within agreed project timelines. "• Collaborate with product engineering and global stakeholders to translate design questions into clear electromagnetic analysis requirements. • Perform electromagnetic analyses for switchgear, busway, switches, UPS systems, circuit protection devices, and associated components and assemblies. • Develop appropriate electrostatic, magnetostatic, eddy-current, transient electromagnetic, and coupled electro-thermal models based on the engineering requirement. • Prepare geometry, generate meshes, assign material properties, define excitations and boundary conditions, and establish appropriate solver settings. • Evaluate quantities such as current density, magnetic flux density, induced currents, electromagnetic forces, losses, electric-field distribution, and dielectric stress as applicable. • Review model assumptions and perform engineering checks to confirm that simulation results are physically reasonable and suitable for design decisions. • Interpret and summarize analysis results, identify electromagnetic risks, and provide technically sound design recommendations to local and global teams. • Develop verification and validation plans, correlate simulation predictions with test data, document gaps, and improve model fidelity. • Create clear technical reports and presentations that document inputs, assumptions, methods, results, conclusions, limitations, and recommendations. • Support parametric studies, design optimization, and sensitivity assessments to improve product performance, reliability, cost, and development cycle time. • Contribute to reusable simulation templates, best practices, automation scripts, and standard work that improve analysis speed, consistency, and repeatability. • Participate in technical reviews and proactively communicate progress, dependencies, technical risks, and schedule risks." Qualifications: Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Power Systems, Power Electronics, Electromagnetics, Electrical Machines, or a closely related discipline. ~0-2 Years of relevant academic, research, or industry experience in engineering analysis, simulation. Skills: "Required: • Strong fundamentals in electromagnetic field theory, electrical machines, power systems, and electrical engineering. • Understanding of electromagnetic-analysis workflows, including geometry preparation, meshing, material definition, excitations, boundary conditions, solver setup, convergence assessment, post-processing, and result interpretation. Preferred: • Exposure to ANSYS Maxwell, ANSYS Electronics Desktop, or equivalent electromagnetic simulation tools. • Exposure to busbar systems, switching devices, circuit protection, electromechanical actuators, transformers, inductive components, or power-electronic equipment. • Basic scripting or automation experience using Python, MATLAB, VBA, or tool-specific scripting interfaces." Practical experience with 3D electromagnetic simulation software, preferably Ansys HFSS or CST Studio Suite. Analytical problem-solving skills and proficiency in English. Experience with large-scale database modernization, cloud adoption, migrations, consolidation, and infrastructure-transformation programs. Broader knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, and distributed/NoSQL technologies. Cloud architecture experience across OCI, Azure, AWS, and hybrid-cloud environments. eightfold:infineon:563808971932857.description: #WeAreIn to program innovative solutions for tomorrow’s challenges. Are you in? As a Software Developer, you will help modernize our toolchain to be OS-agnostic, ensuring smooth execution across Linux, Windows (WSL2), and high-performance compute environments. This is a great opportunity to learn about cross-platform development, CI/CD automation, and developer experience (DX) while directly impacting how engineering teams build products. Are you in? Your role Key responsibilities in your new role Tool Development: Write, maintain, and optimize backend code and command-line interfaces (CLI) using Python and C++ to simplify complex engineering setups. Cross-Platform Engineering: Help refactor legacy scripts to ensure they run flawlessly on both Windows (WSL2) and Linux environments by replacing hardcoded OS dependencies with dynamic environment variables. Data Interoperability: Work with data serialization formats (JSON, XML, YAML) to help standardize how different simulation tools communicate and pass data to one another automatically. CI/CD & Automation: Write automated validation scripts ("linters") that run in our Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to catch errors, enforce coding standards, and prevent bad code from breaking the platform. User Experience (DX): Improve internal tool usability by catching software exceptions and writing clear, human-readable error messages and "fix hints" for users. Testing & QA: Write unit tests and assist in running automated stress tests to ensure software packages install and perform correctly under various conditions. Your profile Qualifications and skills to help you succeed Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (recent graduates or 1-2 years of experience). Programming: Strong foundational skills in Python and/or C++ . Environments: Comfortable working in both Linux and Windows command-line environments. Version Control & CI/CD: Familiarity with Git . Basic understanding of Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment ( CI/CD ) concepts. Data Handling: Basic knowledge of configuration files and data structures ( YAML, JSON ). Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving mindset, eager to learn, and a passion for making tools that make other developers' lives easier. Familiarity with Windows Subsystem for Linux ( WSL ). Basic knowledge of Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools, SystemC , or hardware simulation workflows. Experience writing bash scripts or working with build automation tools. What We Offer: You will be mentored by senior software architects and system engineers in a supportive, high-impact environment. You will gain hands-on experience building scalable, production-grade infrastructure that accelerates the product development lifecycle for a global semiconductor leader. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes. The impact you’ll make Lead a high-performing, research-driven engineering team developing next-generation autonomous robotic systems that service complex semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Design and develop research roadmaps for current and future robotic capability, champion strategic research directions with senior executive leadership, and drive external innovation through university partnerships, research institutions, and emerging robotics/AI startup engagements. What you’ll do · Manage, mentor, and grow a multidisciplinary team of robotics research engineers across four core areas – perception, mobility, Robotic Manipulation & Dexterity, Physical AI/ML · Lead the research, architecture, and end-to-end prototyping of robotics technologies from initial research concept through functional technology-readiness demonstration · Partner with R&D leadership to set the research direction for current and future robotic requirements · Architect high-precision perception systems using cameras and laser scanners for scene understanding sub-millimetre level end-effector manipulation, install-quality validation, defect inspection and calibration · Lead the selection, integration, and control of advanced force-controlled robotic arms and path planning in partnership with arm OEMs (Flexiv, UR, ABB) · Drive the prototyping of custom and general-purpose end effectors and grippers with force feedback, visual servoing, dexterous hands, and compact tool changers to expand task and application coverage · Lead the development of Automated Mobile Robots (AMR) based mobile manipulation systems - integrating robotic arms onto custom and off-the-shelf AMRs with human-safe autonomous navigation, high-precision automated tool docking. · Pioneer Physical AI, multi-modal sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning models—including imitation/mimic learning, reinforcement learning (RL), Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, and sim-to-real deployment pipelines · Establish and manage strategic collaborations with leading universities, academic research labs, and 3rd-party partners - including scouting, evaluating, and partnering with startups and arm/sensor OEMs · Stay at the forefront of the latest state-of-the-art breakthroughs in robotics, computer vision, dexterous manipulation, and Physical AI/ML, translating academic and industry advances into practical, high-precision prototypes for semiconductor fab environments. · Guide projects from initial hypothesis, simulation, and Design of Experiments (DOE) in the robotics lab through hardware/software prototyping and functional technology-readiness demonstrations, ensuring smooth handoff to production engineering. Who we’re looking for MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, with 12+ years of industry/research experience in robotics and autonomous systems, including 3+ years of experience managing research-based, high-performance engineering teams. Deep technical expertise of modern robotics SOTA with demonstrated experience across at least two of the following areas Perception & Computer Vision - 3D vision, calibration, pose estimation, visual inspection, scene understanding Autonomous Mobility - AMR navigation, perception, ROS2 navigation (nav2), SLAM, obstacle detection and avoidance Robotic Manipulation & Dexterity - kinematics/dynamics, force/impedance control, motion/path planning, visual servoing, dexterous hands/end effectors/Grippers Physical AI & Machine Learning - imitation/mimic learning, reinforcement learning, foundation models for robotics/VLAs, sensor fusion, sim-to-real deployment pipelines Proven track record of formulating R&D roadmaps, securing buy-in from senior/executive leadership, and translating ambiguous operational challenges into structured research programs. Demonstrated experience initiating and managing university research sponsorships, academic collaborations, OEM partnerships, or startup evaluations/co-development. Strong grounding in C++, Python, ROS2, and modern robotics software architectures sufficient to review technical designs, guide architectural decisions, and mentor staff/senior researchers. Preferred qualifications • Strong track record of peer-reviewed publications in top-tier robotics, computer vision, or ML venues (e.g., ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL, CVPR, NeurIPS) and/or leadership in open-source robotics initiatives. • Experience with modern robotics simulation and training ecosystems (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo) and hardware integration with industrial/collaborative arms (Flexiv, UR, ABB, Denso). Job Description As a Non-Volatile Memory QRA (NVMQRA) Solid State Drive (SSD) Quality and Reliability Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., you will you will be responsible for managing quality and reliability of Micron SSD products as these products enter into high volume production phase of product lifecycle. You will perform reliability testing and data analysis on material associated with sustaining qualifications through change requests, product proliferations, special work requests and conversions. You will also take part in the management of product deviation events, through participation in product containment activities and providing quality and reliability evaluation plans for risk assessment. You will also manage the outgoing quality and reliability (OQRM) metrics. You are expected to conduct failure analysis from qualification, evaluation and OQRM failures and report the resulting data. You can expect to conduct global meetings to determine product priorities or product dispositions. eightfold:nvidia:893397378585.description: We are seeking a Front-End Integration Engineer for the NIC Silicon group. Join our team at NVIDIA's Networking business unit and be part of the innovative build and implementation of the next generation Network Adapter Silicon chips. Contribute to the development of powerful communication devices. What You'll Be Doing: Own and maintain Continuous Integration pipelines. Monitor, complete, and fix daily and nightly CI flows in front-end build areas. These include Lint, Synthesis, Equivalence Checking and Simulation. Automate EDA Flows: Build, develop, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python, Tcl scripting, and Shell to integrate EDA tools (Synopsys, Cadence) into automated build pipelines. Manage Perforce Integration: Maintain multi-IP branch/stream strategies, manage workspace specs, complete hardware build drops, and handle release labels/tags in Perforce (Helix Core). Support Engineering Teams: Act as the primary point of contact for RTL and verification engineers to debug flow crashes, bottlenecks, environment setups, and CI failure reports. Enforce Quality Gates: Implement automated check-in and change list triggers to run sanity checks, linting, and style enforcement before code is committed to main streams. Optimize Infrastructure: Monitor compute farm resources (LSF) and storage usage to reduce pipeline runtime and improve overall execution efficiency. What We Need to See: Experience: 2+ years of hands-on industry experience in ASIC/SoC front-end integration, CAD, or EDA flow automation. Education: Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Perforce Expertise: Strong hands-on experience managing Perforce (P4 / Helix Core) streams, workspace specs, changelists, and labels within an active hardware build environment. Scripting & Programming: Demonstrated proficiency in Python, Tcl, and Bash/Shell scripting for flow development and task automation. EDA Tools Familiarity: Practical experience with front-end ASIC tools (e.g., SpyGlass, Build Compiler, or Xcelium). A standout colleague who possesses great interpersonal skills Problem Solving: Strong diagnostic and fixing skills with the ability to resolve front-end build and flow issues under project deadlines. Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: P4 Automation & Triggers: Experience writing custom P4 Python scripts or Perforce pre-submit/post-submit triggers to enforce check-in policies automatically. Dashboards development: Hands-on proven experience building automated regression reporting tools, Slack/Teams notifications, or dashboards to track pipeline health and coverage. Diagnose issues and validate high-speed interfaces using modern lab equipment, including DSOs and BERT, with expert-level proficiency. Expert-level proficiency in electrical validation of PCIe (or similar) protocols, hands-on with lab equipment (DSOs, BERT, protocol analyzers), and scripting skills (Perl, Python) for developing test/debug programs. eightfold:paypal:274922911270.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: What you need to know about the role As an Android Software Engineer, you will build and maintain the PayPal POS app on Android phones and on Zettle Terminal hardware. You will work on features across the merchant experience, from sign-in and bootstrap to checkout, receipts, refunds and invoices, and learn how the app talks to card readers and terminals. Meet our team Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned. We are a growing engineering team in Bangalore working closely with colleagues in Sweden, who built much of the platform.
