Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Your way to impact Make checkout and receipts fast and reliable for merchants at the counter, on phones and on terminals. Deliver features across product library, inventory, purchase history, refunds and invoices. Help legacy Zettle merchants move onto PayPal identity with a smooth sign-in and onboarding experience in the app. Improve app stability, release quality and crash-free sessions across a wide range of devices. Your day to day Build and ship features in Kotlin and Java using Jetpack libraries, coroutines and Jetpack Compose. Integrate with backend services over REST and GraphQL; handle auth and session flows. Work with Bluetooth reader connectivity and terminal hardware integration under guidance. Write unit and instrumentation tests, and take part in code reviews, CI/CD and staged releases. Investigate crashes and production issues using analytics and monitoring, and fix root causes. Pair with Sweden engineers and write documentation and runbooks for areas you take over. What do you need to bring- 1 to 3 years of Android development experience with strong Kotlin. Hands-on with Jetpack, coroutines, networking and local persistence; Jetpack Compose is a plus. Experience with unit and instrumentation testing and CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps. Understanding of secure handling of sensitive data on device. Interest in payments; experience with Bluetooth peripherals, NFC or POS hardware is a plus. Nice to have: Java, GraphQL clients, device management and app distribution tooling. Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden. A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records. Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product. eightfold:qualcomm:446715259078.description: Company: Qualcomm India Private Limited Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering General Summary: We are looking for a highly skilled GPU compute, MLIR compiler, and kernel optimization engineer with deep expertise in GPU compute, MLIR-based code generation, and end-to-end performance optimization for AI workloads. In this role, you will design, optimize, and deploy high-performance GPU compute kernels, build and extend MLIR compiler backends, and collaborate closely with ML, runtime, and hardware teams to push the limits of performance on modern GPU architectures. Key Responsibilities Develop and optimize GPU compute kernels targeting OpenCL and Vulkan compute backends for high-throughput AI/ML workloads. Design, build, and extend MLIR dialects across multiple abstraction levels — including frontend dialects, graph-level IR, tensor IR (e.g., Linalg, Tensor, Tosa), and runtime/low-level dialects — to enable efficient end-to-end model compilation. Implement and maintain MLIR-based compiler passes and transformations, including tiling, fusion, bufferization, vectorization, and lowering pipelines targeting OpenCL and Vulkan GPU backends. Conduct profiling and bottleneck analysis of compiled kernels using GPU counters and vendor-specific profilers, and drive performance improvements through compiler-level optimizations. Build and maintain GPU runtime infrastructure for both OpenCL and Vulkan, including memory management, pipeline setup, command buffer orchestration, and resource scheduling. Develop and extend code generation pipelines, enabling automatic lowering from tensor IR through MLIR to efficient OpenCL and Vulkan GPU kernels. Implement performance-critical schedules — tiling, loop fusion, parallelism, and caching strategies — within MLIR-based backends targeting OpenCL and Vulkan runtimes. Collaborate with framework teams to optimize end-to-end model lowering for computer vision and LLM workloads using MLIR compilation stacks. Design and implement robust compiler and runtime components using modern C/C++, leveraging advanced programming paradigms for high-performance systems. Required Qualifications Strong hands-on experience with MLIR framework, including authoring and extending custom dialects, writing compiler passes, and building end-to-end lowering pipelines. Deep expertise across MLIR abstraction levels: Frontend dialects — ingestion and representation of ML models (e.g., TOSA, StableHLO, ONNX-MLIR) Graph-level IR — high-level operation fusion, shape inference, and graph transformations Tensor IR level — structured op representation using Linalg, Tensor, and Vector dialects; tiling and fusion strategies Runtime/low-level dialects — bufferization, MemRef, SCF, GPU, and LLVM dialects for final code generation Strong hands-on experience in OpenCL programming, including kernel development, memory model, work-group/work-item optimization, and OpenCL runtime management. Solid understanding of Vulkan compute programming, including descriptor management, compute pipelines, synchronization primitives, and Vulkan runtime internals. Strong understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchies, and async compute. Proficiency in C/C++ for system-level development. Experience with kernel profiling and bottleneck analysis on GPU platforms. Strong background in machine learning fundamentals, covering both CV and LLM workloads. Good to Have Hands-on experience with IREE (Intermediate Representation Execution Environment) or other MLIR-based deployment frameworks such as TVM, XLA, or LLVM. Familiarity with IREE's compiler and runtime architecture — including HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer), executable compilation, and dispatch mechanisms — particularly its OpenCL and Vulkan HAL backends. Experience contributing to open-source MLIR or IREE projects. Knowledge of quantization, mixed-precision inference, and model optimization techniques for edge and server GPU targets. Exposure to multi-target compilation (CPU, GPU, NPU) using MLIR-based toolchains. Familiarity with cross-vendor GPU profiling tools (e.g., ARM Streamline, Qualcomm Snapdragon Profiler, Intel VTune) for OpenCL and Vulkan workloads. eightfold:qualcomm:446719156242.description: Company: Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering General Summary: Qualcomm's Data Center team is developing high-performance, energy-efficient server solutions for data center applications. We are looking for highly talented, innovative, and collaborative individuals to contribute to cutting-edge server technology development. Our Mission We are dedicated to transforming the industry by reimagining silicon and developing next-generation computing platforms. By joining our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers to create innovative solutions that advance performance, energy efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Our focus is on developing reference platforms based on Qualcomm Snapdragon SoCs and delivering comprehensive hardware and software solutions, reference designs, user guides, SDKs, and related enablement. Position Summary We are seeking a Staff / Senior Staff Server Structural FEA Engineer with deep expertise in semiconductor package mechanics, structural reliability, and advanced finite element analysis. The role focuses on structural integrity and reliability of server SoCs, spanning die- and package-level behavior through interaction with the server platform. The scope includes both soldered and socketed SoC packages and their mechanical interaction with PCBs, sockets and retention systems, cooling solutions, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5. The ideal candidate is a recognized subject matter expert who can develop predictive methodologies, evaluate failure mechanisms, quantify design margins and uncertainty, and translate analysis into actionable package and platform design guidance. The engineer will assess structural behavior across package assembly, system integration, qualification, and operation, with emphasis on chip-package interaction (CPI), warpage, die and interconnect integrity, solder-joint reliability, and mechanically coupled thermal interface risks. This senior individual contributor will work closely with package engineering, computational modeling, thermal, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, reliability, and system/platform engineering teams to align assumptions, material properties, boundary conditions, failure criteria, and correlation approaches. The engineer will develop independent analyses where needed and partner with system-level structural FEA engineers to connect SoC/package mechanical behavior to broader platform and lifecycle assessments. Key Responsibilities Develop and apply advanced structural and thermo-mechanical FEA methodologies for server SoCs and advanced semiconductor packages, including CPI, package assembly, warpage, stress, deformation, and structural reliability. Evaluate both soldered and socketed packages under package assembly, SMT, socket and retention loading, cooling-system loading, temperature cycling, qualification, and operating conditions. Analyze package-to-platform mechanical interaction among the SoC package, PCB, socket or retention system, heatsink or cold plate, and thermal interface materials, including TIM1.5. Apply advanced FEA techniques including submodeling, contact analysis, material and geometric nonlinearity, viscoelasticity, creep, fatigue, fracture or damage mechanics, and coupled structural-thermal analysis as appropriate. Develop physics-based reliability and life-prediction models for relevant failure mechanisms, including solder and bump fatigue, die and BEOL stress, substrate and interposer cracking, delamination, and creep. Perform BLR and solder-joint reliability analyses to quantify damage accumulation, design margins, and expected life. Perform sensitivity, uncertainty, and bounding analyses to identify dominant parameters, quantify structural risk, and guide package and platform architecture decisions before hardware is available. Define model-validation and correlation strategies using material characterization, package/board measurements, reliability and qualification testing, manufacturing data, and system-level test results, including development of test vehicles and methods where needed. Partner with package engineering and computational modeling teams to align modeling assumptions, material properties, process inputs, boundary conditions, revision control, correlation methodologies, and failure criteria. Develop independent analyses, sensitivity studies, or targeted model cross-checks as needed to reconcile differing predictions, quantify uncertainty, and evaluate server-specific package-to-platform boundary conditions. Work closely with system/platform structural-analysis engineers to provide package mechanical properties, load limits, deformation behavior, and failure criteria supporting broader platform, system, and rack-level lifecycle analyses. Apply expertise in package architectures and substrate technologies, including FCBGA, FCLGA/HFCBGA, chiplet-based designs, HBM integration, 2.5D interposers or bridges, and 3D packaging technologies. Develop scalable workflows, automation, modeling standards, best-known methods (BKMs), and validation frameworks. Experience with ANSYS APDL-based workflow development is strongly preferred. Translate complex simulation results into clear design requirements and recommendations for cross-functional engineering teams, leadership, customers, and suppliers. Qualifications Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Mechanics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field. 10+ years of advanced FEA experience in semiconductor packaging, microelectronics assembly, CPI, structural reliability, and interconnect technologies. Strong foundation in structural and failure mechanics, materials science, thermo-mechanical behavior, fatigue and creep, with experience applying nonlinear FEA techniques including contact, submodeling, thermal cycling, and interconnect reliability analysis. Demonstrated experience modeling semiconductor-package failure mechanisms

eightfold:qualcomm:446721041865.description: Company: Qualcomm India Private Limited Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering General Summary: Job Overview: You will be part of System Performance team that is responsible for profiling and optimizing the System Performance on Snapdragon chipsets. This role will require a strong knowledge of AI/ML performance using NPU cores. The knowledge of CPU, DDR, NoCs will be an added advantage. Skills Required: A deep understanding of NPU, CPU and DDR architecture internals like · NPU: Understanding of NPU micro-architecture, including its specialized processing elements for operations like matrix multiplications and convolutions. · A strong grasp of deep learning fundamentals, including neural network architectures like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), transformers, GenAI etc. · Understanding the distinction between the compute-intensive training of a model (often done on GPUs) and running inference (making predictions) on NPUs. · Knowledge of Model optimization and compression techniques (Quantization, Pruning, Distillation etc.) · CPU caches (L1, L2, L3), instruction pipelines, branch prediction, memory hierarchy (including register, cache, and main memory) and multi-core/multi-threaded processing. You need to understand how memory access, instruction dependencies, and contention for shared resources can impact performance. · DDR: Understanding of JEDEC specifications LPDDR4, LPDDR5, LPDDR6, including command and timing parameters (e.g., 𝑡𝐶𝐿, 𝑡𝑅𝐶𝐷, tRP), memory organization (rows, columns, banks), and basic view of training and initialization sequences, how a memory controller works and its specific features like command queue, port arbitration, and various control schemes. • Familiarity with frameworks like TensorFlow Lite, PyTorch Mobile, and ONNX Runtime for preparing models for deployment. Experience with NPU-specific compilers, such as those from Qualcomm (QNN), Arm (Vela), Intel (OpenVINO), to optimize and orchestrate AI workloads. • Evaluating hardware and software to determine the best fit for specific AI tasks and measure performance metrics like TOPS/W (trillions of operations per second per watt). • Using tools like the Windows Performance Toolkit and Qualcomm's Snapdragon Profiler to analyze and optimize NPU and system-level performance • A core understanding of how to use parallel processing architectures for efficient AI computations. • Expertise in how operating systems manage processes, threads, memory, MMU, and interrupt handling. This knowledge is crucial to understanding software for the kernel scheduler and system-level bottlenecks. • Good understanding of Benchmarks CPU (like GeekBench, SpecInt, CoreMark etc) and DDR (like lat_mem, stream, bw_mem etc.) and how they exercise the underlying CPU/GPU/DDR architecture. Experience with a variety of performance monitoring tools like Intel VTune, Linux perf, and Utilities like top, vmstat, iostat, and netstat to monitor system resources like CPU, memory, and I/O. Experience with software tools to monitor system hotspots, command bus utilization, and identify memory traffic patterns is critical. This includes validating that the traffic generated by software is as expected. • Good understanding of memory allocation policies, prefetching, and caching to minimize latency and maximize bandwidth. Understanding how an application accesses memory is vital. Skills in profiling code to analyze memory access patterns and then optimizing the code for better data locality. • Analyzing large datasets from performance tests requires strong statistical skills. This can involve creating histograms of transaction latencies and deriving performance metrics to understand a system's behavior. Responsibilities include: • Drive Performance analysis on silicon using various System and Cores (i.e. NPU, AI/ML, CPU, Memory) benchmarks like Dhrystone, GeekBench, SPECInt, CNN/GenAI ML networks etc. • Use of Performance tools to analyze the load patterns across IPs and identify any performance bottlenecks in system. • Analyzing Perf KPIs of SoC subsystems like NPU, CPU, Memory, and corelate performance with projection • Evaluate and characterize performance at various junction temperatures and optimize running at high ambient temperatures. • Analyze and optimize the System performance parameters of SoC infrastructure like NoC, LP5 DDR, etc. • Collaborate with cross-functional global teams to plan and execute performance activities on chipsets as well as make recommendations for next generation chipsets. Minimum Qualifications: • 1 to 5 years of industry experience in the following: • Experience working on any ARM/x86 based platforms, mobile/automotive/Data center operating systems and/or performance profiling tools. • Experience in application or driver development in Linux\QNX and ability to create/customize make files with various compiler options is a plus. • Must be quick learner and should be able to adapt to new technologies. • Must have excellent communication skills. Preferred Qualifications: Additional skills in the following areas are preferred: • Knowledge of Computer architecture, LP5 DDR, Bus/NOC profiling is a big plus. • Fundamentals on any operating system like Linux/QNX/Hypervisor & experience working on any Data center applications. • Experience in creating professional quality reports and slides using MS Office or any advanced visualization tools. • Experience in PoC development and competitive analysis Knowledge on Voltage/Power/ Thermal domain is plus. Education Requirements: • Required: Bachelor's, Computer Engineering, and/or Electrical Engineering • Preferred: Master's, Computer Engineering, and/or Electrical Engineering Keywords: • Architecture Performance, System Performance, Data Center, Benchmarks, Thermal Performance, Operating systems, Linux, QNX, Hypervisor, Application Development Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related fie

The engineer will work across platform, silicon, system, safety, security, and application teams to drive issues from problem isolation through root cause, corrective action, validation, and release readiness. Technical Leadership and Collaboration • Lead multi-domain investigations and drive alignment when issues span BSP, HLOS, hypervisor, firmware, hardware, power, security, or application layers. • Mentor engineers in debugging methodology, QNX platform architecture, issue analysis, code quality, and customer-oriented execution. • Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, architecture notes, and reusable analysis practices. • Participate in technical reviews, defect reviews, readiness assessments, and continuous-improvement activities. • Identify recurring failure patterns and drive preventive actions in design, testing, automation, integration, and development processes. Required Qualifications • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. • Typically 6+ years of relevant embedded software, operating-system, BSP, platform, or automotive systems experience. • Strong hands-on experience with QNX Neutrino or comparable real-time operating-system concepts and platform integration. • Solid understanding of embedded system architecture: boot flow, BSP components, device drivers, kernel services, interrupts, memory management, scheduling, IPC, synchronization, and resource management. • Experience debugging complex system failures using logs, traces, crash dumps, instrumentation, debuggers, and hardware/software observability mechanisms. • Strong C and C++ programming skills, with ability to read, modify, review, and troubleshoot low-level system software. • Working knowledge of ARM-based SoC systems, firmware interactions, device trees or equivalent hardware description mechanisms, and board-level integration. • Experience with software development life cycle, code review, configuration management, defect tracking, regression testing, and release qualification. • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with automotive platforms, vehicle compute systems, domain controllers, or production embedded products. • Experience with QNX Hypervisor or equivalent virtualization technologies, including VM configuration, inter-domain communication, device assignment, and resource isolation. • Knowledge of platform power management, low-power states, suspend-to-RAM, wake sources, thermal behavior, performance optimization, and power-aware debugging. • Experience with SMMU/IOMMU, DMA, shared memory, ECC/EDAC. • Experience with automated validation, continuous integration, stress testing, fault injection, long-duration stability testing, and system reliability metrics. • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technical programs or serving as a domain subject-matter expert. eightfold:qualcomm:446722188223.description: Company: Qualcomm India Private Limited Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering General Summary: As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives communication and data processing transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm ASIC Engineer, you will define, model, design (digital and/or analog), optimize, verify, validate, implement, and document IP (block/SoC) development for a variety of high performance, high quality, low power world class products. Qualcomm Engineers collaborate with cross-functional groups to determine product execution path. Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. OR PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. This senior-level engineering role focuses on signal integrity ownership for advanced semiconductor packages used in AI accelerators, high-performance computing devices, networking switch ASICs, and data center products. The position spans modeling, simulation, optimization, cross-functional collaboration, and package-to-PCB sign-off for high-speed interconnects. • Advanced package ownership: Responsibilities include analyzing organic substrates, 2.5D interposers, and multi-die packages; modeling bumps, redistribution layers, traces, vias, BGA connections, and package-to-PCB transitions; and optimizing impedance, loss, reflections, and crosstalk. The engineer also supports package floorplanning, bump assignments, ball maps, and substrate stack-updevelopment. • High-speed interface analysis: The role covers 112G and 224G PAM4 SerDes, emerging 448G interfaces, PCIe Gen5 through Gen7, UCIe, DDR5, and LPDDR5X. Required analysis methods include S-parameters, eye diagrams, statistical eye analysis, IBIS-AMI models, loss budgets, jitter, inter-symbol interference, equalization,and timing margins, in collaboration with PHY teams. • Electromagnetic and system integration: The engineer develops 2D and 3D electromagnetic models, extracts and validates broadband S-parameters, and evaluates differential impedance, mode conversion, crosstalk, resonances, routing, vias, reference planes, and return-current paths. Work extends from package-only channels to complete die-package-PCB simulations, including applicable connector, socket, cable, and PCB effects, with recommendations provided before package tape-out. • Leadership and qualifications: The position establishes SI guidelines and sign-off criteria, leads design reviews, works across distributed teams, and mentors junior engineers. Candidates need strong electromagnetic and transmission-line knowledge, advanced package SI experience, proficiency with tools such as Ansys HFSS, SIwave, Cadence Sigrity, Clarity 3D Solver, and Keysight ADS, plus expertise in SerDes analysis, PAM4 equalization, advanced substrates, and relevant interface specifications. A BS, MS, or PhD and 8–15+ years of relevant experience are required; preferred experience includes chiplets, silicon interposers, UCIe, 112G and 224G SerDes, 448G architectures,measurement correlation, power integrity interactions, and Python-based automation Applicants : Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. As a Qualcomm ASIC Engineer, you will define, model, design (digital and/or analog), optimize, verify, validate, implement, and document IP (block/SoC) development for a variety of high performance, high quality, low power world class products. Qualcomm Engineers collaborate with cross-functional groups to determine product execution path. Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. OR PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. This role seeks a senior-level Power Integrity Engineer to lead power delivery network design, simulation, optimization, and validation for advanced semiconductor packages used in AI and data center systems. The position spans die, package, and PCB interactions and requires close collaboration across ASIC, layout, signal integrity, thermal, and system engineering teams. • Power Integrity Analysis: Responsibilities include DC and AC analysis, IR drop and current-density assessment, frequency-domain impedance evaluation, transient simulations, chip power modeling, and analysis of VRMs, decoupling, package parasitics, and on-die capacitance. • Package Optimization: The engineer will optimize power and ground distribution, substrate stackups, planes, vias, bump assignments, BGA maps, and decoupling solutions for low-voltage, high-current supplies and multiple power domains. Work includes 2.5D and 3D integration, chiplets, interposers, embedded capacitors, and tradeoffs involving thermal performance, manufacturability, cost, and schedule. • AI and Data Center Systems: The role supports AI accelerators, GPUs, CPUs, networking ASICs, and data center switches with demanding transient and voltage-noise requirements, including packages using 112G, 224G, and 448G SerDes,PCIe Gen6 and Gen7, UCIe, DDR, and HBM. • Qualifications and Progression: Candidates should understand electromagnetic theory, PDNs, package construction, target impedance, die-package-PCB co-design, and transient analysis; use tools such as Cadence Sigrity, Ansys SIwave and HFSS, Cadence Clarity 3D Solver, and SPICE; and apply scripting for automation. A relevant graduate degree is preferred, while experience expectations range from 5–8 or more years for Senior Engineer to 12 or more years with technical leadership for Principal Engineer. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability. We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. #VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture About this role We are seeking a Network Monitoring Engineer to join our Customer Services & Operations team within the Network Monitoring function. This role is ideal for individuals with a foundational understanding of networking technologies who are looking to build their career in a global telecommunications environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for real-time network monitoring, fault validation, stakeholder communication, and incident reporting across a large-scale customer network. This position operates on a 24x7x365 shift model and provides exposure to IP networks, Cisco technologies, and managed network services delivered to customers around the world. What you will do Monitor customer networks and network elements within defined service level agreements (SLAs). Perform initial fault diagnosis and validate network alarms. Report service-impacting incidents to customers and internal stakeholders in a timely and accurate manner. Create and manage trouble tickets for investigation and resolution by specialist teams. Work closely with technical support teams, incident management teams, service desks, and first-line support functions. Maintain operational excellence to support network availability and minimise service downtime. Ensure accurate communication of faults and associated customer impact. Contribute to continuous process improvements and operational efficiency initiatives. Participate in a 24x7 shift environment to support business and customer requirements. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless customer service delivery. Who you are Essential Qualifications •Engineering degree or Engineering Diploma. •Basic networking knowledge, preferably with exposure to Cisco networking technologies. •Understanding of: oOSI Model oTCP/IP Protocol Suite oBasic Routing and Switching Concepts •Working knowledge of: oWindows Operating Systems oInternet Browsers oMicrosoft Office Applications oEmail Applications •Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. •Methodical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. •Analytical mindset with attention to detail. •Ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment. •Willingness to work rotational 24x7 shifts. Desired Qualifications and Experience •Approximately one year of experience within ISP, Telecom or Managed Services environments. •Experience working in a Network Operations Centre (NOC). •CCNA certification. •Postgraduate qualification in Advanced Networking. •Experience within a Managed Service Organisation. •Exposure to large-scale IP network environments. Behavioural Competencies •Customer obsessed mindset. •Innovation hungry and eager to learn. •Speed and simplicity in execution. •Builds trust through accountability and professionalism. •Collaborative and inclusive approach to teamwork. •Self-motivated with the ability to prioritise effectively during high-pressure situations. •Strong commitment to continuous learning and development. Not a perfect fit Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. Whats in it for you Opportunity to work with large-scale global IP networks and telecommunications infrastructure. Exposure to Cisco networking technologies and enterprise monitoring environments. Experience collaborating with international stakeholders and technical teams. Structured learning within a global managed services organisation. Opportunity to contribute to service improvements and operational excellence initiatives. Career development pathways within network operations and telecommunications services. Hands-on experience in a critical customer operations environment. What skills you will learn Real-time network monitoring and operational management. Incident identification, validation, and fault reporting processes. Network operations centre (NOC) best practices. Stakeholder communication and customer incident management. Service management and SLA-driven operations. Telecommunications and managed services operational processes. Network fault analysis and alarm correlation techniques. Cross-functional collaboration within a global technology organisation. About this Role We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Software Tester with experience in Telecom BSS/OSS environments to support the delivery of high-quality system changes across Fixed Line, Home Broadband, customer care, order management, and provisioning journeys. This role is focused on System Integration Testing (SIT), end-to-end validation, defect management, and quality assurance across complex business and technology landscapes. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure solutions are delivered in line with business requirements, quality standards, and release objectives. What you will do Analyse business and functional requirements, participate in walkthroughs, and assess testing impacts across applications, systems, and customer journeys. Define SIT scope, estimate testing effort, and prepare test plans, schedules, test scenarios, test cases, and requirement traceability artefacts. Execute System Integration Testing, end-to-end testing, integration testing, and regression testing across complex business and technical processes. Validate functional requirements, system integrations, interfaces, data flows, order processing activities, and downstream outcomes. Prepare and maintain suitable test data and ensure supporting test environments are available for planned execution activities. Log, track, retest, and close defects using Microsoft Azure DevOps and actively participate in defect triage discussions. Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with Business, Development, Release Management, and supplier teams to support timely defect resolution. Provide clear updates on test execution, defects, risks, issues, and dependencies, supporting evidence-based Go/No-Go recommendations. Maintain testing metrics, quality dashboards, and test evidence in accordance with SDLC and STLC governance requirements. Apply automation testing knowledge to identify suitable regression scenarios, support automated test execution, analyse results, and collaborate on script maintenance activities. Contribute to reusable test assets, shift-left testing practices, process standardisation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Coordinate test closure activities, capture lessons learned, and support the implementation of agreed improvements in future deliveries. Who you are Minimum of 3 years' experience in software testing across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Proven hands-on experience in System Integration Testing, end-to-end testing, integration testing, regression testing, and defect management. Good understanding of Fixed Line, Home Broadband, telecom customer journeys, order management, and provisioning processes. Experience using testing tools, particularly Microsoft Azure DevOps. Strong knowledge of test planning, requirements traceability, quality metrics, and test reporting. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, root cause analysis, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities. Ability to work effectively within matrix teams involving onshore, offshore, business, technology, and supplier stakeholders. Telecom, BSS/OSS, or customer care domain experience is preferred. ISTQB or ISEB certification is preferred. Experience working within complex, large-scale release environments is desirable. Not a perfect fit? Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity. What's in it for you Opportunity to work on complex telecom customer journeys, order management, and provisioning solutions. Exposure to large-scale enterprise testing programmes and cross-functional delivery environments. Collaboration with global business, technology, and supplier stakeholders. Experience with modern testing governance, metrics, reporting, and Azure DevOps-based quality management. Participation in continuous improvement, automation enablement, and shift-left testing practices. What you’ll do Advanced System Integration Testing and end-to-end testing methodologies. Telecom BSS/OSS domain knowledge and customer journey validation. Defect lifecycle management and root cause analysis techniques. Test planning, traceability management, quality metrics, and governance practices. Test automation support, regression optimisation, and large-scale release testing. Stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration skills within global delivery environments. Experience with supporting diagnostic tools such as Fiddler, browser developer tools, HAR files and Lighthouse would be advantageous. You understand testing standards and structured defect management practices. You communicate effectively with product owners, developers, IT Operations, testing professionals and other stakeholders. This role is ideal for individuals with experience in telecom network operations who are passionate about ensuring network availability, monitoring service performance, identifying incidents, and supporting timely restoration activities. The successful candidate will contribute to the operational excellence of Voice, Data Core and charging platforms across 2G, 3G, LTE and 5G technologies while working closely with operational teams, suppliers and stakeholders. What you will do Monitor Voice and Data Core network alarms, events and service-impacting incidents across NOC platforms in a 24x7 operational environment. Perform first-level fault identification, incident validation, alarm correlation and initial troubleshooting activities. Manage incident handling activities including detection, impact assessment, prioritisation, tracking, escalation and closure. Raise, update and maintain trouble tickets with accurate documentation, impact analysis, actions taken and escalation status. Escalate unresolved incidents to L2/L3 teams, resolver groups, suppliers or vendors in accordance with agreed SLAs and operational procedures. Conduct routine shift activities, operational checks and network health monitoring. Support planned maintenance activities, post-change monitoring and service verification exercises. Operate and support Voice and Data Core networks and charging platforms across 2G, 3G, LTE and 5G SA technologies, including native, VNF and containerised environments. Follow Vodafone operational procedures, security standards, governance requirements and incident management processes. Coordinate with internal support teams, field technicians, suppliers and external stakeholders to support service restoration activities. Review active alarms, incidents and pending tickets to ensure timely follow-up and resolution. Support inventory validation activities and report any discrepancies to relevant teams. Ensure compliance with site access procedures and operational controls during incident handling and resolution activities. Contribute towards achieving agreed operational KPIs and SLAs. Who you are Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science or a related technical discipline. BE/B.Tech in Electronics and Telecommunications preferred. 2 to 5 years of experience in telecommunications network operations, preferably within a NOC or operational support environment. Understanding of GSM, UMTS, LTE and 5G Core technologies. Knowledge of Voice, Data Core and charging platforms. Familiarity with ITIL-based incident management, fault handling, ticket management and escalation processes. Basic understanding of virtualisation technologies, VNF/CNF architectures and containerised network solutions. Ability to monitor alarms, correlate events, identify service impacts and perform first-level troubleshooting. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills when working with internal teams, suppliers and external partners. Ability to perform effectively during major incidents and time-sensitive operational situations. Good written and spoken English with the ability to prepare clear technical updates and incident reports. Willingness to work rotational shifts, including weekends, nights, public holidays and overtime when required. Secondary education completed. Not a Perfect Fit? Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. What’s in it for you Opportunity to work within a global telecom environment supporting critical Video and Data Core services. Exposure to advanced 2G, 3G, LTE and 5G Core network technologies. Experience working with virtualised and containerised telecom network platforms. Participation in major incident management and service restoration activities. Collaboration with international operational teams, suppliers and technical specialists. Development of operational expertise within a high-availability network environment. Exposure to industry-standard NOC operations, service management processes and network monitoring platforms. Strong hands-on experience with AWS Glue, Python, Apache Spark, Amazon Redshift, Amazon Athena and Apache Iceberg. Proven experience designing, developing and supporting enterprise-scale ETL pipelines. Strong understanding of data modelling concepts and best practices. Experience with GitHub, CI/CD practices, API integrations and JSON processing. Familiarity with ITSM processes and tools such as JIRA. Ability to work effectively within geographically distributed and multicultural teams. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. Not a perfect fit? Exposure to modern AWS-native data engineering technologies and architectures. Collaboration with international stakeholders and cross-functional teams across multiple markets. Opportunity to contribute to innovative proof-of-concept initiatives and data transformation programmes. Modern DevOps and CI/CD approaches for data platforms. Cross-functional stakeholder engagement within a large global organisation. Telecom analytics and business data domain knowledge. Scalable data modelling and performance optimisation techniques. This role focuses on the operation, troubleshooting, configuration and optimisation of complex 4G LTE EPC and 5G Core networks supporting mission-critical telecommunications services. You will work across technologies including MME, SGW, PGW, PCRF, HSS, AMF, SMF, UPF, UDM and PCF , resolving complex network incidents and supporting network evolution, integration and service continuity. The role requires strong knowledge of 4G/5G signalling and call flows , telecom protocols, Linux and cloud-native environments, combined with hands-on troubleshooting and automation capabilities. You will collaborate with Operations, Planning, Delivery, vendors and Vodafone operating companies to maintain network performance and meet agreed SLAs and KPIs. The position operates within a 24x7 telecom environment and may involve weekend, night and overtime working depending on operational requirements. What you’ll do Troubleshoot and resolve complex 4G LTE EPC and 5G Core network incidents within agreed SLAs, restoring service quality and continuity. Investigate high-complexity technical issues escalated by first-line and other operational teams and provide appropriate remediation. Analyse attach failures, registration failures, bearer issues, data-session problems, roaming incidents and signalling faults . Perform packet and protocol trace analysis using tools including Wireshark and tcpdump . Configure, integrate and optimise network software parameters in line with defined quality and operational requirements. Support network functions including MME, SGW, PGW, PCRF, HSS, AMF, SMF, UPF, UDM and PCF . Analyse 4G/5G signalling and procedures including LTE attach, 5G registration, PDU session establishment, handovers and roaming . Troubleshoot protocols including Diameter, GTPv2-C, GTP-U, PFCP, SIP, SCTP, DNS, HTTP/2, MAP and TCP/IP . Execute preventive and corrective maintenance to reduce recurring faults and maintain network performance. Conduct periodic preventive system checks to identify latent software and hardware deficiencies. Support parameter configuration, controlled network changes, rollouts and integration activities aligned with network development plans. Evaluate network changes to maintain quality of service and minimise regression risks. Support Linux, VMware and Kubernetes-based environments , including system health monitoring, logging and performance management. Develop and adapt automation and operational solutions using Python, Shell scripting, Ansible, REST APIs and CI/CD practices . Introduce and improve operational processes using automation and AI to increase efficiency and consistency. Support High Availability, Geo-Redundancy, Disaster Recovery, NFV and cloud-native network deployments . Participate in Business Continuity Plan execution and identify practical workarounds or alternative solutions during critical interventions and disaster-recovery scenarios. Escalate complex technical problems to relevant vendors and collaborate through resolution. Engage with Major Incident Management during critical outages in accordance with established escalation procedures. Provide accurate and timely incident communications to agreed stakeholder groups. Coordinate with vendors, other departments and Vodafone operating companies to meet agreed service levels. Support field engineers and Planning, Integration and Deployment teams during complex interventions. Maintain operational procedures and network documentation. Share technical knowledge and troubleshooting practices with teams supporting network deployment and operations. Contribute to Incident, Problem, Change and Major Incident Management processes within a 24x7 operational environment. Who you are You have: A BE/B.Tech in Electronics & Telecommunications . 6–8 years of experience in Mobile Network Operations . Strong expertise in 4G LTE EPC and 5G Core architectures , including network functions, interfaces, operational processes and solution design. Hands-on experience with MME, SGW, PGW, PCRF, HSS, AMF, SMF, UPF, UDM and PCF . Strong understanding of subscriber mobility, session management, bearer management, policy control, charging, roaming, VoLTE and VoNR . Detailed understanding of 4G/5G signalling and call flows , including attach, registration, PDU session establishment, handovers and roaming procedures. Practical expertise in Diameter, GTPv2-C, GTP-U, PFCP, SIP, SCTP, DNS, HTTP/2, MAP and TCP/IP . Proven experience troubleshooting attach, bearer, data-session, roaming and signalling-related problems. Experience analysing packet and protocol traces using Wireshark and tcpdump . Hands-on knowledge of Linux administration, VMware and Kubernetes-based orchestration . Experience with system health monitoring, log analysis and performance manag

kula:digantara:53973.description: Digantara is a leading Space Surveillance and Intelligence company focused on orbital safety and sustainability. Its integrated sensing, processing, and analytics capabilities enable detection, tracking, identification, and monitoring of Resident Space Objects across orbital regimes. Digantara is seeking an Adaptive Optics Design Engineer to design and realize advanced optical systems for ground-based space surveillance. The engineer will work on telescope optics, adaptive optics architectures, wavefront sensing and correction, atmospheric turbulence compensation, optical alignment, image-quality optimization, and electro-optical system integration. Why Us: Work on advanced space-surveillance technology with significant ownership of engineering outcomes. Develop advanced optics systems for Space Situational Awareness applications. Responsibilities: Translate mission requirements into optical requirements. Evaluate adaptive optics architectures for atmospheric turbulence compensation, and high- resolution imaging. Derive adaptive optics actuator and wavefront sensor requirements. Design relay optics involving telescopes, wavefront sensors, deformable mirrors, tip-tilt mirrors, and detectors etc. Perform tolerance analysis, wavefront-error budgeting, and timing analysis. Define optical alignment and testing methods required for the full system integration. Work with controls and software teams on implementation of closed-loop AO control. Support laboratory integration, characterization, root-cause analysis, performance improvement, on field testing, and telescope commissioning. Document optical design layouts and performance details, interface specifications, tolerance budgets, BoMs, calibration procedures, and test plans. Required Qualification: 5-8 years of relevant industry or research experience in optical system design, adaptive optics, or related electro-optical systems. Strong fundamentals in geometrical and physical optics, aberrations, wavefront sensing, atmosphere turbulence, and adaptive-optics correction. Demonstrated experience with Zemax OpticStudio, or equivalent optical-design software and numerical modelling using Python or MATLAB. Experience with turbulence simulation, closed-loop AO control, real-time processing, and aberration calibration. Hands-on experience with wavefront sensors, deformable or tip-tilt mirrors, scientific cameras, alignment, and laboratory characterization. General Requirements: Ability to own engineering activities from requirements through design, integration, validation, and field deployment. Ability to work effectively with other engineering teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills. Excellent communication skills, willingness to participate in laboratory and field testing, and occasional travel as necessary. Job Location: Hebbal, Bengaluru Work Type: WFO with five working days Embrace your role in reshaping the future of space operatio n s . Join us as we forge the new frontier Come, work at Digantara and be at the forefront of groundbreaking developments Why Us? Why work at Digantara? The technology we build here is industry leading and state of the art, providing great personal fulfilment as well as opportunities for professional advancement.” Sushmita Chauhan Associate “I’m excited about being part of a fast growing company and getting to tackle never been solved before challenges. kula:digantara:54539.description: Digantara is a leading Space Surveillance and Intelligence​ company focused on ensuring orbital safety and sustainability. With expertise in space-based detection, tracking, identification, and monitoring, Digantara provides comprehensive domain awareness across regimes, allowing end users to have actionable intelligence on a single platform. At the core of its infrastructure lies a sophisticated integration of hardware and software capabilities aligned with the key principles of situational awareness: perception (data collection) , comprehension (data processing) , and prediction (analytics) . This holistic approach empowers Digantara to monitor all Resident Space Objects (RSOs) in orbit, fostering comprehensive domain awareness. Digantara is seeking a Quality Control Engineer - Optics with specializing in the Quality assurance of fabrication of Lenses, Mirrors and Testing of Telescopes. You will leverage your expertise to enable state-of-the-art embedded hardware development with applications such as tracking objects from both space and the ground. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with a variety of manufacturing processes, a deep understanding of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T), and a proven track record in maintaining and enforcing industrial standards. This position involves regular interaction with external manufacturing vendors, developing and implementing quality standards, and ensuring strict compliance throughout the supply chain. Why Us? Be part of a collaborative and innovative environment where your ideas and skills make a real difference to the entire space realm. Competitive incentives, galvanizing workspace, blazing team, frequent outings—pretty much everything you have heard about a startup + you get to work on space technology. Hustle in a well-funded startup allowing you to take charge of your responsibilities and create your moonshot. Ideal Candidate: Hands-on QA/QC experience in precision optical manufacturing, inspection of optical/opto-mechanical components, and testing of electro-optical payloads, with strong coordination with manufacturing vendors. Strong expertise in optical inspection, GD&T, engineering drawings, interferometric and MTF testing, optical metrology instruments, and understanding of optical fabrication, coating, alignment, integration, and assembly processes. Hand on experience with Zygo Interferometer, Collimator, Opticentric, Spectrophotometer etc. Responsibilities Develop, implement, and continuously improve QC/QA processes for optical, opto-mechanical, and payload components used in space-based and ground-based systems. Conduct detailed inspections, audits, and optical performance testing to verify compliance with optical drawings, GD&T, surface quality, alignment, and technical specifications. Establish, document, and communicate optical manufacturing and inspection standards, ensuring vendors strictly follow quality and process requirements. Maintain comprehensive records of quality assurance activities, inspection reports, test results, non-conformities, and vendor performance. kula:digantara:55016.description: Digantara is a leading Space Surveillance and Intelligence company focused on ensuring orbital safety and sustainability. With expertise in space-based detection, tracking, identification, and monitoring, Digantara provides comprehensive domain awareness across regimes, allowing end users to have actionable intelligence on a single platform. At the core of its infrastructure lies a sophisticated integration of hardware and software capabilities aligned with the key principles of situational awareness: perception (data collection) , comprehension (data processing) , and prediction (analytics) . This holistic approach empowers Digantara to monitor all Resident Space Objects (RSOs) in orbit, fostering comprehensive domain awareness. Ideal Candidate: Someone with 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in spacecraft or high-reliability electronics test who can take a checkout system and make it productive - building out test content, running spacecraft-level campaigns on it, and producing evidence that stands up in review. Responsibilities: Develop, and maintain test sequences, limit sets, and automation content within the delivered checkout platform, structured so that test content remains portable if the underlying platform changes. Verify power, data, and timing interfaces at the bus-to-payload boundary: regulated and unregulated rails, RS422/485, CAN, LVDS, Gigabit Ethernet, bi-level discretes, PPS timing, and temperature monitor channels. Plan and execute spacecraft-level campaigns - payload integration, functional, self-compatibility, thermal vacuum, and end-to-end test - and generate test procedures, test reports, and non-conformance reports. Troubleshoot checkout system faults to the point of isolating vendor versus in-house responsibility, and provide the technical detail needed to open and close vendor support cases. Maintain configuration control of the checkout system across module swaps, firmware and software updates, so results remain comparable across a multi-unit build. Maintain electronics lab and Ground Support Equipment infrastructure (equipment configuration, calibration schedules, cabling, ESD-safe workstations) and train technicians and interns on checkout system operation. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics/Electrical/Instrumentation, or a relevant technical discipline. 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in electronics hardware testing, validation, or integration in satellite/launch vehicle avionics, or other high-reliability domains. Demonstrated ownership of a test campaign from procedure authoring through execution to signed test report. Working experience with a commercial test platform ecosystem - NI (PXI, TestStand, VeriStand, LabVIEW) or Keysight (PathWave) - sufficient to develop and maintain test sequences independently of vendor support. Ability to work from electrical and software interface control documents and turn them into executable test cases with clear pass/fail criteria. Proficiency in using lab equipment i.e., oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, digital multimeters, and protocol analysers for bring-up, debug and functional testing. Understanding of data communication protocols SPI, I2C, UART, RS422/485, CAN, LVDS, and Gigabit Ethernet, including termination, isolation, and fail-safe behaviour. Working proficiency in Python for test automation and data handling. Hands-on soldering and rework skills including through-hole and surface-mount components for prototyping, repair, and test fixture assembly. Preferred Skills: Ability to debug a framed wire protocol at packet level - framing, CRC integrity, sequence handling - sufficient to diagnose faults independently rather than escalating every issue to the vendor. Lead troubleshooting of networking, routing, DNS, TLS, authentication, and connectivity challenges. Endpoint & Threat Defense: Hands-on experience with macOS and Windows hardening, EDR/AV solutions, and endpoint management tools. Troubleshooting & Technical Depth: Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills across networking, authentication, and OS platforms. Collaboration & Scripting: Experience with or comfort configuring automation and agent-based tools. And strong communication skills with the ability to explain security decisions to both technical engineers and business stakeholders. kula:rocketlane:54840.description: About Rocketlane Rocketlane is a B2B SaaS platform for client onboarding and project delivery, and we're building Nitro, our AI-native product layer. We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to own product and infrastructure security for the company. What you'll own This is a hands-on, individual-contributor security role covering the full range of product security work, not just one slice of it. Offensive security and vulnerability discovery Run internal penetration tests across our web app, APIs, mobile app, and cloud infrastructure, and triage findings from external pentest vendors Actively hunt for vulnerabilities in new features, including in AI/LLM-powered surfaces (prompt injection paths, unsafe code execution in agent tooling, unauthenticated internal endpoints) Have found and driven the fix for real vulnerabilities before. We need someone who thinks like an attacker, not just someone who runs a scanner and files a ticket Cloud and infrastructure security Review and harden our AWS setup: WAF rules, ALB/CloudFront TLS policies and cipher suites, container isolation, IAM and secrets hygiene Investigate and close out Dependabot and other CI/CD security alerts across dozens of repos, and work with engineering teams to get fixes prioritized and shipped Build and maintain internal security tooling Compliance and customer trust Help with our compliance audit cycles end to end: evidence collection, control testing, and coordinating with auditors. This typically takes up 5% of the work. Respond to customer security questionnaires and InfoSec review requests, working with sales and customer success to turn these around quickly and accurately Keep our security documentation and posture current as the product and infrastructure evolve Cross-team coordination Work directly with engineering, platform, and ops teams to get security fixes prioritized and shipped, not just logged Report critical findings up to leadership with clear, actionable writeups (source, sink, impact, fix) What we're looking for 3+ years in a hands-on security role covering penetration testing and vulnerability research, ideally across web, API, mobile, and cloud Real, demonstrable experience finding and helping fix serious vulnerabilities (RCE, auth bypass, injection classes), not just running automated scans Solid working knowledge of AWS security: WAF, ALB/CloudFront, IAM, container security on ECS or similar Comfort integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning) and driving remediation with engineering teams Experience with, or strong interest in, securing LLM/AI-powered applications: unsafe code execution, prompt injection, agent tool-call boundaries Strong written communication. You'll be writing up findings for engineers and explaining risk to non-technical stakeholders in the same week Nice to have Experience building or maintaining internal security scanning tools Familiarity with Java/Spring Boot stacks (our backend) or Python (our AI/LLM stack) A CTF background, bug bounty track record, or security certifications (OSCP, etc.) Prior exposure to SOC 2 or similar compliance frameworks and customer-facing security questionnaires would be a plus Why this role You'd be the primary security engineer for a fast-moving product company actively shipping AI agent features, with direct access to leadership and real ownership over what gets fixed and when. kula:rocketlane:54953.description: About Rocketlane Rocketlane is a fast-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation. Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries. We’re a close-knit team of over 200 passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fuelled by $105M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Profile Overview We're hiring a GTM Engineer to own the systems and data infrastructure that power Rocketlane's go-to-market engine. This role sits at the center of our sales and pipe gen tech stack - CRM, outbound tooling, inbound routers, PRM, and the integrations that connect them. You'll be the person who makes sure data flows cleanly across systems, the right accounts get in front of the right reps, and decisions like territory planning and account scoring are backed by a clean, well-structured data model. You'll work closely with Revenue, and Pipe Gen leaders. Your mission: keep the GTM tech stack running as one coherent system instead of a pile of disconnected tools, and make sure territory planning, routing, and account scoring sit on solid foundations. Expect high ownership, deep systems/API work, and close partnership with pipe gen leaders on experiments. What You'll Do Own the CRM end-to-end: data model, structure, hygiene, and scalability as the sales org grows Own the broader sales/pipe gen tech stack: outbound tech stack, inbound routers, PRM, and related systems Build seamless integrations across systems: data sync, alerts, and workflows that just work Own territory planning: the single most important strategic initiative for a fast-growing sales org Codify our ICP into account scoring and prioritization models Build and maintain lists for outbound and experiments using modern GTM tooling (Clay, Bitscale, etc.) Be a thought partner to pipe gen leaders: help design and run experiments, and support on the GTM engineering side Provide general support to sales and pipe gen teams (lowest priority - this is a builder seat, not a ticket queue) What We're Looking For 2 to 6 years of experience in RevOps, sales ops, or marketing ops (not an LDR/SDR or MRE-to-ops path) Hands-on experience with HubSpot/Salesforce: comfortable inside the CRM's data model, not just its UI Experience building lists with modern GTM tooling (Clay, Bitscale, or similar) Solid understanding of integrations, APIs, and tokens: you're comfortable wiring systems together, not just using them Data and BI tools experience is a plus Strong process thinker with an eye for efficiency, and a builder mindset Good with numbers, with strong analytical skills and attention to detail - you spot trends, catch errors, and back decisions with data Clear communicator who can bridge business needs and system design High ownership operator who thrives in fast-paced environments Curious about the latest in GTM tooling, especially AI and automation across the sales/pipeline stack Why join us? At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays: Impact and ownership : You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen. Work with the best : We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes. Celebrate wins : Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big. Learn and grow : We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it). Flexibility and balance : While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office). kula:slice:64069.description: About the role : We run the production infrastructure behind a regulated, digital-first bank payment rails, core banking workloads, and customer-facing services on a multi-account AWS estate managed through code and GitOps. It's a place where reliability and trust matter deeply, and where the systems you look after have real consequences for real customers. We're looking for an SRE-1 who enjoys that kind of responsibility: someone who keeps systems stable, automates away the repetitive work, and brings a steady hand when things break. You'll make changes through well-defined, safe paths, debug production with curiosity, and treat reliability and compliance as part of the same craft rather than competing goals. This is a hands-on production role. You'll own real systems, share the on-call rotation with the team, and grow into the judgment that banking infrastructure rewards. What you will do: Operate and maintain production cloud infrastructure with a focus on availability, stability, and risk reduction. Make infrastructure and configuration changes through approved patterns and GitOps workflows, so changes stay reviewable, repeatable, and safe. Support Kubernetes-based production workloads across our environments: deployments, scaling, rollouts, and day-2 operations like debugging, recovery, and resource tuning. Monitor system health through metrics, logs, and alerts, and use them to find and fix the root of a problem. Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, and recovery for production systems. Contribute to root cause analysis and help implement the preventive actions that come out of post-incident reviews. Build automation for operational tasks (runbooks, scripts, Terraform) to reduce manual effort and free the team up for higher-value work. Help maintain the security, compliance, and governance controls that keep a regulated banking environment healthy. Take part in disaster recovery work DR drills, failover, cross-region posture as a meaningful part of what we deliver. Keep runbooks, SOPs, and operational documentation useful and up to date. Collaborate with DevEx and application teams to help their services land smoothly in production. What you will need: Must-Have Core engineering 1–3 years in SRE / Infrastructure / Production Operations roles. Hands-on AWS experience in production: core services (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS/Aurora, load balancing) with genuine operational depth, and comfort working within a multi-account setup. Working knowledge of Kubernetes with day-2 experience you can debug a CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKill, failed rollout, or in-cluster DNS issue, not only deploy manifests. Strong Linux fundamentals with real troubleshooting depth you're comfortable reasoning through a hung process, disk or inode exhaustion, a failing systemd unit, or a tricky networking issue. Networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTPS/TLS, load balancing) solid enough to reason about latency and connectivity during a live incident. Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch), using it to form and test hypotheses when you debug. Hands-on Terraform and Git for infrastructure change, including writing reusable, scalable modules, with a good feel for plan/apply, state, and code review. Ability to write automation scripts (Bash required; Python strongly preferred). How you work You value safe, reviewable change. You're happy working through approved patterns and change windows, because you know that's what keeps a shared production environment trustworthy. You think in terms of GitOps Git as the source of truth and you're mindful of blast radius and keeping workloads well isolated. You're ready to share the on-call rotation, and you tend to stay calm and methodical when things get busy. You lean toward least-privilege and just-in-time access as a natural way of working, and you're comfortable with the audit trails that come with a bank. You see compliance (RBI, NPCI, PCI) as a set of guardrails to design within, and you're good at finding solutions that work well inside them. You treat documentation as part of the job updating runbooks and SOPs so the next person (often future-you) has an easier time. You use AI tooling well pairing it with your own engineering judgment rather than leaning on it blindly and you're mindful that tokens and compute have a cost, not something to take for granted. Good-to-Have Exposure to high-availability and disaster recovery setups (multi-AZ, cross-region replication, active-passive/active-active). Experience with web servers (nginx, Apache). Working knowledge of databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, ElasticSearch etc.) enough to triage alongside our DBAs. Prior experience in a regulated or compliance-heavy environment (banking, fintech, payments). Multicloud exposure, especially with major cloud providers. Hands-on experience across a broader set of Terraform providers. Python or Go for building operational tooling. Life at slice: Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding: Competitive salaries. Period. An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependents. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise. Flexible working hours. oracle_hcm:jpmorgan-chase:210809554.description: There’s nothing more exciting than being at the center of a rapidly growing field in technology and applying your skillsets to drive innovation and modernize the world's most complex and mission-critical systems. As a Site Reliability Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Global ESX Infrastructure Platforms SRE team (IP - CFP), you will solve complex and broad business problems with simple and straightforward solutions. Through code and cloud infrastructure, you will configure, maintain, monitor, and optimize applications and their associated infrastructure to independently decompose and iteratively improve on existing solutions. You are a significant contributor to your team by sharing your knowledge of end-to-end operations, availability, reliability, and scalability of your application or platform. Job responsibilities Own the reliability and availability of critical applications and infrastructure on VCF 5.x and VCF 9 platforms—including vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, vSAN, and NSX—in large-scale production environments, working under senior-engineer guidance and following runbooks and engineering standards. Execute controlled service changes in accordance with ITIL change management, including patching and upgrades with vLCM and SDDC Manager, capacity changes, configuration-drift remediation, and pre- and post-change checks. Troubleshoot complex issues across VMware, compute, storage, and networking, including host failures and PSODs, vSAN health and latency, HA restarts, and vMotion issues. Lead incident response for assigned services with senior-engineer support; restore service, participate in on-call, and use operational data and root-cause analysis to prevent recurring issues. Monitor vCenter alarms, VCF Operations, and VCF Operations for Logs; triage and escalate alerts, improve dashboards and alert rules, and use service level indicators and objectives to identify and address reliability risks before customers are affected. Build and contribute to automation with guidance, including infrastructure as code, deployment and CI/CD workflows, self-healing remediation, monitoring and alerting, patch management, drift detection, resource optimization, reporting, and testing. Use tools such as Python, pyVmomi, REST APIs, VCF/Aria Automation, VCF/Aria Orchestrator, and Terraform, with peer review and version control. Conduct assigned performance and capacity assessments and translate findings into measurable improvements; apply enterprise-authorized AI capabilities to support incident triage, troubleshooting, post-incident analysis, and identification of recurring toil, validating outputs and following data-sensitivity and security requirements. Partner with engineering teams and stakeholders to design, test, and implement reliable deployment approaches; contribute to infrastructure, configuration, and network as code, strengthen SRE practices, maintain runbooks and knowledge articles, support newer engineers, and identify improvements to address business needs. Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate incident triage, troubleshooting, and post-incident analysis, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements. Applies enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to identify patterns in operational signals that indicate reliability risk or recurring toil, prioritizing reuse-first improvements tied to SLO outcomes Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Formal training or certification on site reliability engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience Relevant years of experience in network, software, or systems engineering, with increasing ownership, including enterprise experience with VMware ESXi and vSAN and hands-on troubleshooting and service changes in VCF 5.x or VCF 9, vCenter, HA/DRS, and NSX. Current VMware certification, such as VCP-DCV or VCP-VCF Administrator. Strong production operations, systems, networking, and problem-solving skills, including data center networking knowledge (BGP, VRF, MPLS, IP, TCP, and UDP) and storage and virtualization concepts. Scripting or software development experience, primarily in Python, with proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java/Spring Boot, or .NET; familiarity with Agile development, automated testing, and CI/CD tooling. Experience with ITIL incident, problem, and change management and ITSM tools such as ServiceNow in a regulated production environment; familiarity with VCF Operations and VCF Operations for Logs, observability, SLO alerting, and telemetry collection. Demonstrated ability to lead tasks in Agile teams and collaborate across technical and non-technical groups; communicate and document effectively, work under guidance, follow standards, escalate appropriately, learn quickly, and use enterprise-authorized AI capabilities responsibly by validating recommendations and protecting sensitive data. Advanced English proficiency is required. Working knowledge of using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support SRE workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity Ability to validate AI-assisted operational recommendations before applying changes, escalating when uncertain and following data sensitivity requirements Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Apply experience with VMware NSX-T or Hyper-V. Improve observability, incident management, and post-incident practices. Use or explore AI-assisted engineering or operations. Build automation using VCF/Aria Automation, Aria Orchestrator, Terraform, Ansible, automation frameworks, Git-based CI/CD pipelines, HPE iLO or Dell iDRAC, firmware lifecycle practices, PowerShell/PowerCLI, or JavaScript for Aria Orchestrator.
